saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: If you happen to have read another book about Christopher Robin, you may remember that he once had a swan (or the swan had Christopher Robin, I don't know which) and that he used to call this swan Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: That was a long time ago, and when we said good-bye, we took the name with us, as we didn't think the swan would want it any more.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: Well, when Edward Bear said that he would like an exciting name all to himself, Christopher Robin said at once, without stopping to think, that he was Winnie-the-Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: And he was.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: So, as I have explained the Pooh part, I will now explain the rest of it.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
Introduction
saetze.text: You can't be in London for long without going to the Zoo.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: There are some people who begin the Zoo at the beginning, called WAYIN, and walk as quickly as they can past every cage until they get to the one called WAYOUT, but the nicest people go straight to the animal they love the most, and stay there.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: So when Christopher Robin goes to the Zoo, he goes to where the Polar Bears are, and he whispers something to the third keeper from the left, and doors are unlocked, and we wander through dark passages and up steep stairs, until at last we come to the special cage, and the cage is opened, and out trots something brown and furry, and with a happy cry of "Oh, Bear!" Christopher Robin rushes into its arms.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: Now this bear's name is Winnie, which shows what a good name for bears it is, but the funny thing is that we can't remember whether Winnie is called after Pooh, or Pooh after Winnie.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: We did know once, but we have forgotten....

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
Introduction
saetze.text: I had written as far as this when Piglet looked up and said in his squeaky voice, "What about _Me_?"

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: "My dear Piglet," I said, "the whole book is about you."

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: "So it is about Pooh," he squeaked.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: You see what it is.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: He is jealous because he thinks Pooh is having a Grand Introduction all to himself.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: Pooh is the favourite, of course, there's no denying it, but Piglet comes in for a good many things which Pooh misses; because you can't take Pooh to school without everybody knowing it, but Piglet is so small that he slips into a pocket, where it is very comforting to feel him when you are not quite sure whether twice seven is twelve or twenty-two.

saetze.text: Sometimes he slips out and has a good look in the ink-pot, and in this way he has got more education than Pooh, but Pooh doesn't mind.

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: Some have brains, and some haven't, he says, and there it is.

Introduction
saetze.text: And now all the others are saying, "What about _Us_?"

saetze.kapitel: Introduction
saetze.text: So perhaps the best thing to do is to stop writing Introductions and get on with the book.

saetze.text: "Not very much."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Ah, well, perhaps from up here it looks different. And, as I say, you never can tell with bees."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: There was no wind to blow him nearer to the tree, so there he stayed. He could see the honey, he could smell the honey, but he couldn't quite reach the honey.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: After a little while he called down to you.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Christopher Robin!" he said in a loud whisper.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Hallo!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "I think the bees _suspect_ something!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "What sort of thing?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "I don't know. But something tells me that they're _suspicious_!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.alt: The bear floats in the air hanging from a balloon, surrounded by bees.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Perhaps they think that you're after their honey."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "It may be that. You never can tell with bees."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: There was another little silence, and then he called down to you again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Christopher Robin!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Yes?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Have you an umbrella in your house?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "I think so."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "I wish you would bring it out here, and walk up and down with it, and look up at me every now and then, and say 'Tut-tut, it looks like rain.' I think, if you did that, it would help the deception which we are practising on these bees."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: Well, you laughed to yourself, "Silly old Bear!" but you didn't say it aloud because you were so fond of him, and you went home for your umbrella.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Oh, there you are!" called down Winnie-the-Pooh, as soon as you got back to the tree. "I was beginning to get anxious. I have discovered that the bees are now definitely Suspicious."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Shall I put my umbrella up?" you said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Yes, but wait a moment. We must be practical. The important bee to deceive is the Queen Bee. Can you see which is the Queen Bee from down there?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "No."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "A pity. Well, now, if you walk up and down with your umbrella, saying, 'Tut-tut, it looks like rain,' I shall do what I can by singing a little Cloud Song, such as a cloud might sing.... Go!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: So, while you walked up and down and wondered if it would rain, Winnie-the-Pooh sang this song:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text:
How sweet to be a Cloud
Floating in the Blue!
Every little cloud
_Always_ sings aloud.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text:
"How sweet to be a Cloud
Floating in the Blue!"
It makes him very proud
To be a little cloud.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: The bees were still buzzing as suspiciously as ever. Some of them, indeed, left their nests and flew all round the cloud as it began the second verse of this song, and one bee sat down on the nose of the cloud for a moment, and then got up again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Christopher--_ow!_--Robin," called out the cloud.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Yes?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "I have just been thinking, and I have come to a very important decision. _These are the wrong sort of bees._"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Are they?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Quite the wrong sort. So I should think they would make the wrong sort of honey, shouldn't you?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Would they?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Yes. So I think I shall come down."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "How?" asked you.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: Winnie-the-Pooh hadn't thought about this. If he let go of the string, he would fall--_bump_--and he didn't like the idea of that. So he thought for a long time, and then he said:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Christopher Robin, you must shoot the balloon with your gun. Have you got your gun?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Of course I have," you said. "But if I do that, it will spoil the balloon," you said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "But if you _don't_," said Pooh, "I shall have to let go, and that would spoil _me_."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: When he put it like this, you saw how it was, and you aimed very carefully at the balloon, and fired.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "_Ow!_" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Did I miss?" you asked.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "You didn't exactly _miss_," said Pooh, "but you missed the _balloon_."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "I'm so sorry," you said, and you fired again, and this time you hit the balloon, and the air came slowly out, and Winnie-the-Pooh floated down to the ground.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: But his arms were so stiff from holding on to the string of the balloon all that time that they stayed up straight in the air for more than a week, and whenever a fly came and settled on his nose he had to blow it off. And I think--but I am not sure--that _that_ is why he was always called Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Is that the end of the story?" asked Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "That's the end of that one. There are others."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "About Pooh and Me?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "And Piglet and Rabbit and all of you. Don't you remember?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "I do remember, and then when I try to remember, I forget."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "That day when Pooh and Piglet tried to catch the Heffalump----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "They didn't catch it, did they?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "No."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Pooh couldn't, because he hasn't any brain. Did _I_ catch it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Well, that comes into the story."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: Christopher Robin nodded.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "I do remember," he said, "only Pooh doesn't very well, so that's why he likes having it told to him again. Because then it's a real story and not just a remembering."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "That's just how _I_ feel," I said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: Christopher Robin gave a deep sigh, picked his Bear up by the leg, and walked off to the door, trailing Pooh behind him. At the door he turned and said, "Coming to see me have my bath?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "I might," I said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "I didn't hurt him when I shot him, did I?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: "Not a bit."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
Chapter I: In Which We Are Introduced to Winnie-the-Pooh and Some Bees, and the Stories Begin
saetze.text: He nodded and went out, and in a moment I heard Winnie-the-Pooh--_bump, bump, bump_--going up the stairs behind him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Edward Bear, known to his friends as Winnie-the-Pooh, or Pooh for short, was walking through the forest one day, humming proudly to himself.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: He had made up a little hum that very morning, as he was doing his Stoutness Exercises in front of the glass: _Tra-la-la, tra-la-la_, as he stretched up as high as he could go, and then _Tra-la-la, tra-la--oh, help!--la_, as he tried to reach his toes.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: After breakfast he had said it over and over to himself until he had learnt it off by heart, and now he was humming it right through, properly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: It went like this:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text:
_Tra-la-la, tra-la-la,_
_Tra-la-la, tra-la-la,_
_Rum-tum-tiddle-um-tum._
_Tiddle-iddle, tiddle-iddle,_
_Tiddle-iddle, tiddle-iddle,_
_Rum-tum-tum-tiddle-um._

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Well, he was humming this hum to himself, and walking along gaily, wondering what everybody else was doing, and what it felt like, being somebody else, when suddenly he came to a sandy bank, and in the bank was a large hole.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Aha!" said Pooh. (_Rum-tum-tiddle-um-tum._) "If I know anything about anything, that hole means Rabbit," he said, "and Rabbit means Company," he said, "and Company means Food and Listening-to-Me-Humming and such like. _Rum-tum-tum-tiddle-um._"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: So he bent down, put his head into the hole, and called out:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Is anybody at home?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: There was a sudden scuffling noise from inside the hole, and then silence.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "What I said was, 'Is anybody at home?'" called out Pooh very loudly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "No!" said a voice; and then added, "You needn't shout so loud. I heard you quite well the first time."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Bother!" said Pooh. "Isn't there anybody here at all?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Nobody."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Winnie-the-Pooh took his head out of the hole, and thought for a little, and he thought to himself, "There must be somebody there, because somebody must have _said_ 'Nobody.'" So he put his head back in the hole, and said:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Hallo, Rabbit, isn't that you?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "No," said Rabbit, in a different sort of voice this time.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "But isn't that Rabbit's voice?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "I don't _think_ so," said Rabbit. "It isn't _meant_ to be."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: He took his head out of the hole, and had another think, and then he put it back, and said:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Well, could you very kindly tell me where Rabbit is?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "He has gone to see his friend Pooh Bear, who is a great friend of his."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "But this _is_ Me!" said Bear, very much surprised.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "What sort of Me?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Pooh Bear."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Are you sure?" said Rabbit, still more surprised.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Quite, quite sure," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Oh, well, then, come in."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.alt: The bear squeezes halfway into Rabbit's burrow; he barely fits through the hole.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: So Pooh pushed and pushed and pushed his way through the hole, and at last he got in.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "You were quite right," said Rabbit, looking at him all over. "It _is_ you. Glad to see you."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Who did you think it was?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Well, I wasn't sure. You know how it is in the Forest. One can't have _anybody_ coming into one's house. One has to be _careful_. What about a mouthful of something?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Pooh always liked a little something at eleven o'clock in the morning, and he was very glad to see Rabbit getting out the plates and mugs; and when Rabbit said, "Honey or condensed milk with your bread?" he was so excited that he said, "Both," and then, so as not to seem greedy, he added, "But don't bother about the bread, please." And for a long time after that he said nothing ... until at last, humming to himself in a rather sticky voice, he got up, shook Rabbit lovingly by the paw, and said that he must be going on.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Must you?" said Rabbit politely.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Well," said Pooh, "I could stay a little longer if it--if you----" and he tried very hard to look in the direction of the larder.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "As a matter of fact," said Rabbit, "I was going out myself directly."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Oh, well, then, I'll be going on. Good-bye."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Well, good-bye, if you're sure you won't have any more."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "_Is_ there any more?" asked Pooh quickly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Rabbit took the covers off the dishes, and said, "No, there wasn't."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "I thought not," said Pooh, nodding to himself. "Well, good-bye. I must be going on."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: So he started to climb out of the hole. He pulled with his front paws, and pushed with his back paws, and in a little while his nose was out in the open again ... and then his ears ... and then his front paws ... and then his shoulders ... and then----

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Oh, help!" said Pooh. "I'd better go back."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Oh, bother!" said Pooh. "I shall have to go on."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "I can't do either!" said Pooh. "Oh, help _and_ bother!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Now by this time Rabbit wanted to go for a walk too, and finding the front door full, he went out by the back door, and came round to Pooh, and looked at him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Hallo, are you stuck?" he asked.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "N-no," said Pooh carelessly. "Just resting and thinking and humming to myself."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Here, give us a paw."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Pooh Bear stretched out a paw, and Rabbit pulled and pulled and pulled....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "_Ow!_", cried Pooh. "You're hurting!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "The fact is," said Rabbit, "you're stuck."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "It all comes," said Pooh crossly, "of not having front doors big enough."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "It all comes," said Rabbit sternly, "of eating too much. I thought at the time," said Rabbit, "only I didn't like to say anything," said Rabbit, "that one of us was eating too much," said Rabbit, "and I knew if wasn't _me_," he said. "Well, well, I shall go and fetch Christopher Robin."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Christopher Robin lived at the other end of the Forest, and when he came back with Rabbit, and saw the front half of Pooh, he said, "Silly old Bear," in such a loving voice that everybody felt quite hopeful again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "I was just beginning to think," said Bear, sniffing slightly, "that Rabbit might never be able to use his front door again. And I should _hate_ that," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "So should I," said Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Use his front door again?" said Christopher Robin. "Of course he'll use his front door again."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Good," said Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "If we can't pull you out, Pooh, we might push you back."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Rabbit scratched his whiskers thoughtfully, and pointed out that, when once Pooh was pushed back, he was back, and of course nobody was more glad to see Pooh than _he_ was, still there it was, some lived in trees and some lived underground, and----

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "You mean I'd _never_ get out?" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "I mean," said Rabbit, "that having got _so_ far, it seems a pity to waste it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Christopher Robin nodded.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Then there's only one thing to be done," he said. "We shall have to wait for you to get thin again."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "How long does getting thin take?" asked Pooh anxiously.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "About a week, I should think."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "But I can't stay here for a _week_!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "You can _stay_ here all right, silly old Bear. It's getting you out which is so difficult."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "We'll read to you," said Rabbit cheerfully. "And I hope it won't snow," he added. "And I say, old fellow, you're taking up a good deal of room in my house--_do_ you mind if I use your back legs as a towel-horse? Because, I mean, there they are--doing nothing--and it would be very convenient just to hang the towels on them."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "A week!" said Pooh gloomily. "_What about meals?_"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "I'm afraid no meals," said Christopher Robin, "because of getting thin quicker. But we _will_ read to you."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: Bear began to sigh, and then found he couldn't because he was so tightly stuck; and a tear rolled down his eye, as he said:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: "Then would you read a Sustaining Book, such as would help and comfort a Wedged Bear in Great Tightness?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: So for a week Christopher Robin read that sort of book at the North end of Pooh, and Rabbit hung his washing on the South end ... and in between Bear felt himself getting slenderer and slenderer. And at the end of the week Christopher Robin said, "_Now!_"

align.de: Bär, wie er schlanker und schlanker

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: So he took hold of Pooh's front paws and Rabbit took hold of Christopher Robin, and all Rabbit's friends and relations took hold of Rabbit, and they all pulled together....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: And for a long time Pooh only said "_Ow!_" ...

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.alt: Christopher Robin, Rabbit, Rabbit's friends and relations, Piglet, some mice and a hedgehog all pull in a long line on the bear, still stuck in the hole.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: And then, all of a sudden, he said "_Pop!_" just as if a cork were coming out of a bottle.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: And Christopher Robin and Rabbit and all Rabbit's friends and relations went head-over-heels backwards ... and on the top of them came Winnie-the-Pooh--free!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
Chapter II: In Which Pooh Goes Visiting and Gets into a Tight Place
saetze.text: So, with a nod of thanks to his friends, he went on with his walk through the forest, humming proudly to himself. But, Christopher Robin looked after him lovingly, and said to himself, "Silly old Bear!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.alt: Piglet in front of the very big old beech-tree that is his house; his small clothes dry on a washing line.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: The Piglet lived in a very grand house in the middle of a beech-tree, and the beech-tree was in the middle of the forest, and the Piglet lived in the middle of the house.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: Next to his house was a piece of broken board which had: "TRESPASSERS W" on it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: When Christopher Robin asked the Piglet what it meant, he said it was his grandfather's name, and had been in the family for a long time, Christopher Robin said you _couldn't_ be called Trespassers W, and Piglet said yes, you could, because his grandfather was, and it was short for Trespassers Will, which was short for Trespassers William.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: And his grandfather had had two names in case he lost one--Trespassers after an uncle, and William after Trespassers.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "I've got two names," said Christopher Robin carelessly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Well, there you are, that proves it," said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: One fine winter's day when Piglet was brushing away the snow in front of his house, he happened to look up, and there was Winnie-the-Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: Pooh was walking round and round in a circle, thinking of something else, and when Piglet called to him, he just went on walking.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Hallo!" said Piglet, "what are _you_ doing?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Hunting," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Hunting what?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Tracking something," said Winnie-the-Pooh very mysteriously.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Tracking what?" said Piglet, coming closer.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "That's just what I ask myself. I ask myself, What?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "What do you think you'll answer?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "I shall have to wait until I catch up with it," said Winnie-the-Pooh. "Now, look there." He pointed to the ground in front of him. "What do you see there?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Tracks," said Piglet. "Paw-marks." He gave a little squeak of excitement. "Oh, Pooh! Do you think it's a--a--a Woozle?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "It may be," said Pooh. "Sometimes it is, and sometimes it isn't. You never can tell with paw-marks."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: With these few words he went on tracking, and Piglet, after watching him for a minute or two, ran after him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: Winnie-the-Pooh had come to a sudden stop, and was bending over the tracks in a puzzled sort of way.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "What's the matter?" asked Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "It's a very funny thing," said Bear, "but there seem to be _two_ animals now. This--whatever-it-was--has been joined by another--whatever-it-is--and the two of them are now proceeding in company. Would you mind coming with me, Piglet, in case they turn out to be Hostile Animals?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: Piglet scratched his ear in a nice sort of way, and said that he had nothing to do until Friday, and would be delighted to come, in case it really _was_ a Woozle.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "You mean, in case it really is two Woozles," said Winnie-the-Pooh, and Piglet said that anyhow he had nothing to do until Friday.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: So off they went together.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.alt: The bear and Piglet follow tracks in the snow around a small spinney of trees.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: There was a small spinney of larch trees just here, and it seemed as if the two Woozles, if that is what they were, had been going round this spinney; so round this spinney went Pooh and Piglet after them; Piglet passing the time by telling Pooh what his Grandfather Trespassers W had done to Remove Stiffness after Tracking, and how his Grandfather Trespassers W had suffered in his later years from Shortness of Breath, and other matters of interest, and Pooh wondering what a Grandfather was like, and if perhaps this was Two Grandfathers they were after now, and, if so, whether he would be allowed to take one home and keep it, and what Christopher Robin would say.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: And still the tracks went on in front of them....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: Suddenly Winnie-the-Pooh stopped, and pointed excitedly in front of him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "_Look!_"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "_What?_" said Piglet, with a jump.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: And then, to show that he hadn't been frightened, he jumped up and down once or twice more in an exercising sort of way.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "The tracks!" said Pooh. "_A third animal has joined the other two!_"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Pooh!" cried Piglet. "Do you think it is another Woozle?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "No," said Pooh, "because it makes different marks. It is either Two Woozles and one, as it might be, Wizzle, or Two, as it might be, Wizzles and one, if so it is, Woozle. Let us continue to follow them."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: So they went on, feeling just a little anxious now, in case the three animals in front of them were of Hostile Intent.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: And Piglet wished very much that his Grandfather T. W. were there, instead of elsewhere, and Pooh thought how nice it would be if they met Christopher Robin suddenly but quite accidentally, and only because he liked Christopher Robin so much.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: And then, all of a sudden, Winnie-the-Pooh stopped again, and licked the tip of his nose in a cooling manner, for he was feeling more hot and anxious than ever in his life before.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: _There were four animals in front of them!_

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Do you see, Piglet? Look at their tracks! Three, as it were, Woozles, and one, as it was, Wizzle. _Another Woozle has joined them!_"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: And so it seemed to be.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: There were the tracks; crossing over each other here, getting muddled up with each other there; but, quite plainly every now and then, the tracks of four sets of paws.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "I _think_," said Piglet, when he had licked the tip of his nose too, and found that it brought very little comfort, "I _think_ that I have just remembered something. I have just remembered something that I forgot to do yesterday and shan't be able to do to-morrow. So I suppose I really ought to go back and do it now."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "We'll do it this afternoon, and I'll come with you," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "It isn't the sort of thing you can do in the afternoon," said Piglet quickly. "It's a very particular morning thing, that has to be done in the morning, and, if possible, between the hours of----What would you say the time was?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "About twelve," said Winnie-the-Pooh, looking at the sun.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Between, as I was saying, the hours of twelve and twelve five. So, really, dear old Pooh, if you'll excuse me----_What's that?_"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: Pooh looked up at the sky, and then, as he heard the whistle again, he looked up into the branches of a big oak-tree, and then he saw a friend of his.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "It's Christopher Robin," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Ah, then you'll be all right," said Piglet. "You'll be quite safe with _him_. Good-bye," and he trotted off home as quickly as he could, very glad to be Out of All Danger again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: Christopher Robin came slowly down his tree.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Silly old Bear," he said, "what _were_ you doing? First you went round the spinney twice by yourself, and then Piglet ran after you and you went round again together, and then you were just going round a fourth time----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Wait a moment," said Winnie-the-Pooh, holding up his paw.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: He sat down and thought, in the most thoughtful way he could think.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: Then he fitted his paw into one of the Tracks ... and then he scratched his nose twice, and stood up.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Yes," said Winnie-the-Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "I see now," said Winnie-the-Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "I have been Foolish and Deluded," said he, "and I am a Bear of No Brain at All."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "You're the Best Bear in All the World," said Christopher Robin soothingly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Am I?" said Pooh hopefully. And then he brightened up suddenly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: "Anyhow," he said, "it is nearly Luncheon Time."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
Chapter III: In Which Pooh and Piglet Go Hunting and Nearly Catch a Woozle
saetze.text: So he went home for it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.alt: Eeyore, the old grey donkey, stands with his nose to the ground at the base of a tree, in a thistly corner.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: The Old Grey Donkey, Eeyore, stood by himself in a thistly corner of the forest, his front feet well apart, his head on one side, and thought about things.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Sometimes he thought sadly to himself, "Why?" and sometimes he thought, "Wherefore?" and sometimes he thought, "Inasmuch as which?"--and sometimes he didn't quite know what he _was_ thinking about.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: So when Winnie-the-Pooh came stumping along, Eeyore was very glad to be able to stop thinking for a little, in order to say "How do you do?" in a gloomy manner to him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "And how are you?" said Winnie-the-Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Eeyore shook his head from side to side.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Not very how," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "I don't seem to have felt at all how for a long time."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Dear, dear," said Pooh, "I'm sorry about that.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Let's have a look at you."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: So Eeyore stood there, gazing sadly at the ground, and Winnie-the-Pooh walked all round him once.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Why, what's happened to your tail?" he said in surprise.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "What _has_ happened to it?" said Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "It isn't there!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Are you sure?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Well, either a tail _is_ there or it isn't there.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: You can't make a mistake about it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: And yours _isn't_ there!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Then what is?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Nothing."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Let's have a look," said Eeyore, and he turned slowly round to the place where his tail had been a little while ago, and then, finding that he couldn't catch it up, he turned round the other way, until he came back to where he was at first, and then he put his head down and looked between his front legs, and at last he said, with a long, sad sigh, "I believe you're right."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Of course I'm right," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "That Accounts for a Good Deal," said Eeyore gloomily.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "It Explains Everything.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: No Wonder."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "You must have left it somewhere," said Winnie-the-Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Somebody must have taken it," said Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "How Like Them," he added, after a long silence.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Pooh felt that he ought to say something helpful about it, but didn't quite know what.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: So he decided to do something helpful instead.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Eeyore," he said solemnly, "I, Winnie-the-Pooh, will find your tail for you."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Thank you, Pooh," answered Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "You're a real friend," said he.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Not like Some," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: So Winnie-the-Pooh went off to find Eeyore's tail.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: It was a fine spring morning in the forest as he started out.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Little soft clouds played happily in a blue sky, skipping from time to time in front of the sun as if they had come to put it out, and then sliding away suddenly so that the next might have his turn.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Through them and between them the sun shone bravely; and a copse which had worn its firs all the year round seemed old and dowdy now beside the new green lace which the beeches had put on so prettily.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Through copse and spinney marched Bear; down open slopes of gorse and heather, over rocky beds of streams, up steep banks of sandstone into the heather again; and so at last, tired and hungry, to the Hundred Acre Wood.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: For it was in the Hundred Acre Wood that Owl lived.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "And if anyone knows anything about anything," said Bear to himself, "it's Owl who knows something about something," he said, "or my name's not Winnie-the-Pooh," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Which it is," he added.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "So there you are."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Owl lived at The Chestnuts, an old-world residence of great charm, which was grander than anybody else's, or seemed so to Bear, because it had both a knocker _and_ a bell-pull.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Underneath the knocker there was a notice which said:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: PLES RING IF AN RNSER IS REQIRD.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Underneath the bell-pull there was a notice which said:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: PLEZ CNOKE IF AN RNSR IS NOT REQID.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.alt: The bear stands before Owl's front door high up in a branch of a big old tree, studying the notices by the bell-pull and the knocker.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: These notices had been written by Christopher Robin, who was the only one in the forest who could spell; for Owl, wise though he was in many ways, able to read and write and spell his own name WOL, yet somehow went all to pieces over delicate words like MEASLES and BUTTEREDTOAST.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Winnie-the-Pooh read the two notices very carefully, first from left to right, and afterwards, in case he had missed some of it, from right to left.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Then, to make quite sure, he knocked and pulled the knocker, and he pulled and knocked the bell-rope, and he called out in a very loud voice, "Owl! I require an answer! It's Bear speaking."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: And the door opened, and Owl looked out.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Hallo, Pooh," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "How's things?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Terrible and Sad," said Pooh, "because Eeyore, who is a friend of mine, has lost his tail.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: And he's Moping about it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: So could you very kindly tell me how to find it for him?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Well," said Owl, "the customary procedure in such cases is as follows."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "What does Crustimoney Proseedcake mean?" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "For I am a Bear of Very Little Brain, and long words Bother me."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "It means the Thing to Do."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "As long as it means that, I don't mind," said Pooh humbly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "The thing to do is as follows.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: First, Issue a Reward.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Then----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Just a moment," said Pooh, holding up his paw.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "_What_ do we do to this--what you were saying?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: You sneezed just as you were going to tell me."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "I _didn't_ sneeze."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Yes, you did, Owl."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Excuse me, Pooh, I didn't.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: You can't sneeze without knowing it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Well, you can't know it without something having been sneezed."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "What I _said_ was, 'First _Issue_ a Reward'."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "You're doing it again," said Pooh sadly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "A Reward!" said Owl very loudly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "We write a notice to say that we will give a large something to anybody who finds Eeyore's tail."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "I see, I see," said Pooh, nodding his head.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Talking about large somethings," he went on dreamily, "I generally have a small something about now--about this time in the morning," and he looked wistfully at the cupboard in the corner of Owl's parlour; "just a mouthful of condensed milk or whatnot, with perhaps a lick of honey----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Well, then," said Owl, "we write out this notice, and we put it up all over the forest."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "A lick of honey," murmured Bear to himself, "or--or not, as the case may be."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: And he gave a deep sigh, and tried very hard to listen to what Owl was saying.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: But Owl went on and on, using longer and longer words, until at last he came back to where he started, and he explained that the person to write out this notice was Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "It was he who wrote the ones on my front door for me.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Did you see them, Pooh?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: For some time now Pooh had been saying "Yes" and "No" in turn, with his eyes shut, to all that Owl was saying, and having said, "Yes, yes," last time, he said "No, not at all," now, without really knowing what Owl was talking about.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Didn't you see them?" said Owl, a little surprised.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Come and look at them now."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: So they went outside.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: And Pooh looked at the knocker and the notice below it, and he looked at the bell-rope and the notice below it, and the more he looked at the bell-rope, the more he felt that he had seen something like it, somewhere else, sometime before.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Handsome bell-rope, isn't it?" said Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Pooh nodded.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "It reminds me of something," he said, "but I can't think what.
