saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Where did you get it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "I just came across it in the Forest.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: It was hanging over a bush, and I thought at first somebody lived there, so I rang it, and nothing happened, and then I rang it again very loudly, and it came off in my hand, and as nobody seemed to want it, I took it home, and----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Owl," said Pooh solemnly, "you made a mistake.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: Somebody did want it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Who?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: My dear friend Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: He was--he was fond of it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Fond of it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: "Attached to it," said Winnie-the-Pooh sadly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.alt: Christopher Robin nails Eeyore's tail back on; Eeyore bends round to look; the bear watches with a smile.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: So with these words he unhooked it, and carried it back to Eeyore; and when Christopher Robin had nailed it on in its right place again, Eeyore frisked about the forest, waving his tail so happily that Winnie-the-Pooh came over all funny, and had to hurry home for a little snack of something to sustain him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text: And, wiping his mouth half an hour afterwards, he sang to himself proudly:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
Chapter IV: In Which Eeyore Loses a Tail and Pooh Finds One
saetze.text:
_Who found the Tail?_
"I," said Pooh,
"At a quarter to two
(Only it was quarter to eleven really),
_I_ found the Tail!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.alt: The bear, Piglet and Christopher Robin sit around a picnic blanket with a honey pot, plates and teacups; the boy talks with one foot in the air, the bear and Piglet listen.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: One day, when Christopher Robin and Winnie-the-Pooh and Piglet were all talking together, Christopher Robin finished the mouthful he was eating and said carelessly: "I saw a Heffalump to-day, Piglet."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "What was it doing?" asked Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Just lumping along," said Christopher Robin. "I don't think it saw _me_."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "I saw one once," said Piglet. "At least, I think I did," he said. "Only perhaps it wasn't."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "So did I," said Pooh, wondering what a Heffalump was like.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "You don't often see them," said Christopher Robin carelessly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Not now," said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Not at this time of year," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Then they all talked about something else, until it was time for Pooh and Piglet to go home together.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: At first as they stumped along the path which edged the Hundred Acre Wood, they didn't say much to each other; but when they came to the stream and had helped each other across the stepping stones, and were able to walk side by side again over the heather, they began to talk in a friendly way about this and that, and Piglet said, "If you see what I mean, Pooh," and Pooh said, "It's just what I think myself, Piglet," and Piglet said, "But, on the other hand, Pooh, we must remember," and Pooh said, "Quite true, Piglet, although I had forgotten it for the moment."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: And then, just as they came to the Six Pine Trees, Pooh looked round to see that nobody else was listening, and said in a very solemn voice:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Piglet, I have decided something."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "What have you decided, Pooh?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "I have decided to catch a Heffalump."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Pooh nodded his head several times as he said this, and waited for Piglet to say "How?" or "Pooh, you couldn't!" or something helpful of that sort, but Piglet said nothing.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: The fact was Piglet was wishing that _he_ had thought about it first.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "I shall do it," said Pooh, after waiting a little longer, "by means of a trap. And it must be a Cunning Trap, so you will have to help me, Piglet."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Pooh," said Piglet, feeling quite happy again now, "I will." And then he said, "How shall we do it?" and Pooh said, "That's just it. How?" And then they sat down together to think it out.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Pooh's first idea was that they should dig a Very Deep Pit, and then the Heffalump would come along and fall into the Pit, and----

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Why?" said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Why what?" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Why would he fall in?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Pooh rubbed his nose with his paw, and said that the Heffalump might be walking along, humming a little song, and looking up at the sky, wondering if it would rain, and so he wouldn't see the Very Deep Pit until he was half-way down, when it would be too late.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Piglet said that this was a very good Trap, but supposing it were raining already?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Pooh rubbed his nose again, and said that he hadn't thought of that.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: And then he brightened up, and said that, if it were raining already, the Heffalump would be looking at the sky wondering if it would _clear up_, and so he wouldn't see the Very Deep Pit until he was half-way down.... When it would be too late.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Piglet said that, now that this point had been explained, he thought it was a Cunning Trap.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Pooh was very proud when he heard this, and he felt that the Heffalump was as good as caught already, but there was just one other thing which had to be thought about, and it was this.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: _Where should they dig the Very Deep Pit?_

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Piglet said that the best place would be somewhere where a Heffalump was, just before he fell into it, only about a foot farther on.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "But then he would see us digging it," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Not if he was looking at the sky."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "He would Suspect," said Pooh, "if he happened to look down." He thought for a long time and then added sadly, "It isn't as easy as I thought. I suppose that's why Heffalumps hardly _ever_ get caught."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "That must be it," said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: They sighed and got up; and when they had taken a few gorse prickles out of themselves they sat down again; and all the time Pooh was saying to himself, "If only I could _think_ of something!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: For he felt sure that a Very Clever Brain could catch a Heffalump if only he knew the right way to go about it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Suppose," he said to Piglet, "_you_ wanted to catch _me_, how would you do it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Well," said Piglet, "I should do it like this. I should make a Trap, and I should put a Jar of Honey in the Trap, and you would smell it, and you would go in after it, and----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "And I would go in after it," said Pooh excitedly, "only very carefully so as not to hurt myself, and I would get to the Jar of Honey, and I should lick round the edges first of all, pretending that there wasn't any more, you know, and then I should walk away and think about it a little, and then I should come back and start licking in the middle of the jar, and then----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Yes, well never mind about that. There you would be, and there I should catch you. Now the first thing to think of is, What do Heffalumps like? I should think acorns, shouldn't you? We'll get a lot of----I say, wake up, Pooh!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Pooh, who had gone into a happy dream, woke up with a start, and said that Honey was a much more trappy thing than Haycorns.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Piglet didn't think so; and they were just going to argue about it, when Piglet remembered that, if they put acorns in the Trap, _he_ would have to find the acorns, but if they put honey, then Pooh would have to give up some of his own honey, so he said, "All right, honey then," just as Pooh remembered it too, and was going to say, "All right, haycorns."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Honey," said Piglet to himself in a thoughtful way, as if it were now settled. "_I'll_ dig the pit, while _you_ go and get the honey."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Very well," said Pooh, and he stumped off.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: As soon as he got home, he went to the larder; and he stood on a chair, and took down a very large jar of honey from the top shelf.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: It had HUNNY written on it, but, just to make sure, he took off the paper cover and looked at it, and it _looked_ just like honey.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "But you never can tell," said Pooh. "I remember my uncle saying once that he had seen cheese just this colour." So he put his tongue in, and took a large lick.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Yes," he said, "it is. No doubt about that. And honey, I should say, right down to the bottom of the jar. Unless, of course," he said, "somebody put cheese in at the bottom just for a joke. Perhaps I had better go a _little_ further ... just in case ... in case Heffalumps _don't_ like cheese ... same as me.... Ah!" And he gave a deep sigh. "I _was_ right. It _is_ honey, right the way down."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Having made certain of this, he took the jar back to Piglet, and Piglet looked up from the bottom of his Very Deep Pit, and said, "Got it?" and Pooh said, "Yes, but it isn't quite a full jar," and he threw it down to Piglet, and Piglet said, "No, it isn't! Is that all you've got left?" and Pooh said "Yes." Because it was.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: So Piglet put the jar at the bottom of the Pit, and climbed out, and they went off home together.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Well, good night, Pooh," said Piglet, when they had got to Pooh's house. "And we meet at six o'clock to-morrow morning by the Pine Trees, and see how many Heffalumps we've got in our Trap."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Six o'clock, Piglet. And have you got any string?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "No. Why do you want string?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "To lead them home with."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Oh! ... I _think_ Heffalumps come if you whistle."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Some do and some don't. You never can tell with Heffalumps. Well, good night!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Good night!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: And off Piglet trotted to his house TRESPASSERS W, while Pooh made his preparations for bed.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Some hours later, just as the night was beginning to steal away, Pooh woke up suddenly with a sinking feeling.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: He had had that sinking feeling before, and he knew what it meant.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: _He was hungry._

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: So he went to the larder, and he stood on a chair and reached up to the top shelf, and found--nothing.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "That's funny," he thought. "I know I had a jar of honey there. A full jar, full of honey right up to the top, and it had HUNNY written on it, so that I should know it was honey. That's very funny." And then he began to wander up and down, wondering where it was and murmuring a murmur to himself. Like this:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text:
It's very, very funny,
'Cos I _know_ I had some honey;
'Cos it had a label on,
Saying HUNNY.
A goloptious full-up pot too,
And I don't know where it's got to,
No, I don't know where it's gone--
Well, it's funny.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: He had murmured this to himself three times in a singing sort of way, when suddenly he remembered.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: He had put it into the Cunning Trap to catch the Heffalump.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Bother!" said Pooh. "It all comes of trying to be kind to Heffalumps." And he got back into bed.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: But he couldn't sleep.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: The more he tried to sleep, the more he couldn't.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: He tried Counting Sheep, which is sometimes a good way of getting to sleep, and, as that was no good, he tried counting Heffalumps.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: And that was worse.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Because every Heffalump that he counted was making straight for a pot of Pooh's honey, _and eating it all_.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: For some minutes he lay there miserably, but when the five hundred and eighty-seventh Heffalump was licking its jaws, and saying to itself, "Very good honey this, I don't know when I've tasted better," Pooh could bear it no longer.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: He jumped out of bed, he ran out of the house, and he ran straight to the Six Pine Trees.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: The Sun was still in bed, but there was a lightness in the sky over the Hundred Acre Wood which seemed to show that it was waking up and would soon be kicking off the clothes.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: In the half-light the Pine Trees looked cold and lonely, and the Very Deep Pit seemed deeper than it was, and Pooh's jar of honey at the bottom was something mysterious, a shape and no more.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: But as he got nearer to it his nose told him that it was indeed honey, and his tongue came out and began to polish up his mouth, ready for it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Bother!" said Pooh, as he got his nose inside the jar. "A Heffalump has been eating it!" And then he thought a little and said, "Oh, no, _I_ did. I forgot."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Indeed, he had eaten most of it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: But there was a little left at the very bottom of the jar, and he pushed his head right in, and began to lick....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.alt: An odd creature: its bottom looks like the bear, but where the head should be there is a honey jar.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: By and by Piglet woke up.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: As soon as he woke he said to himself, "Oh!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Then he said bravely, "Yes," and then, still more bravely, "Quite so."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: But he didn't feel very brave, for the word which was really jiggeting about in his brain was "Heffalumps."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: What was a Heffalump like?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Was it Fierce?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: _Did_ it come when you whistled? And _how_ did it come?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Was it Fond of Pigs at all?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: If it was Fond of Pigs, did it make any difference _what sort of Pig_?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Supposing it was Fierce with Pigs, would it make any difference _if the Pig had a grandfather called TRESPASSERS WILLIAM_?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: He didn't know the answer to any of these questions ... and he was going to see his first Heffalump in about an hour from now!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Of course Pooh would be with him, and it was much more Friendly with two.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: But suppose Heffalumps were Very Fierce with Pigs _and_ Bears?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Wouldn't it be better to pretend that he had a headache, and couldn't go up to the Six Pine Trees this morning?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: But then suppose that it was a very fine day, and there was no Heffalump in the trap, here he would be, in bed all the morning, simply wasting his time for nothing.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: What should he do?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: And then he had a Clever Idea.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: He would go up very quietly to the Six Pine Trees now, peep very cautiously into the Trap, and see if there _was_ a Heffalump there.

align.de: jetzt ganz leise zu den Sechs Kiefern

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: And if there was, he would go back to bed, and if there wasn't, he wouldn't.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: So off he went.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: At first he thought that there wouldn't be a Heffalump in the Trap, and then he thought that there would, and as he got nearer he was _sure_ that there would, because he could hear it heffalumping about it like anything.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Oh, dear, oh, dear, oh, dear!" said Piglet to himself. And he wanted to run away. But somehow, having got so near, he felt that he must just see what a Heffalump was like. So he crept to the side of the Trap and looked in....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: And all the time Winnie-the-Pooh had been trying to get the honey-jar off his head.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: The more he shook it, the more tightly it stuck.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "_Bother!_" he said, inside the jar, and "_Oh, help!_" and, mostly, "_Ow!_" And he tried bumping it against things, but as he couldn't see what he was bumping it against, it didn't help him; and he tried to climb out of the Trap, but as he could see nothing but jar, and not much of that, he couldn't find his way. So at last he lifted up his head, jar and all, and made a loud, roaring noise of Sadness and Despair ... and it was at that moment that Piglet looked down.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.alt: The bear in the pit, struggling furiously to get the honey jar off his head.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Help, help!" cried Piglet, "a Heffalump, a Horrible Heffalump!" and he scampered off as hard as he could, still crying out, "Help, help, a Herrible Hoffalump! Hoff, Hoff, a Hellible Horralump! Holl, Holl, a Hoffable Hellerump!" And he didn't stop crying and scampering until he got to Christopher Robin's house.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Whatever's the matter, Piglet?" said Christopher Robin, who was just getting up.

align.de: Was um alles in der Welt

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Heff," said Piglet, breathing so hard that he could hardly speak, "a Heff--a Heff--a Heffalump."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Where?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Up there," said Piglet, waving his paw.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "What did it look like?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Like--like----It had the biggest head you ever saw, Christopher Robin. A great enormous thing, like--like nothing. A huge big--well, like a--I don't know--like an enormous big nothing. Like a jar."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Well," said Christopher Robin, putting on his shoes, "I shall go and look at it. Come on."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Piglet wasn't afraid if he had Christopher Robin with him, so off they went....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "I can hear it, can't you?" said Piglet anxiously, as they got near.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "I can hear _something_," said Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: It was Pooh bumping his head against a tree-root he had found.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "There!" said Piglet. "Isn't it _awful_?" And he held on tight to Christopher Robin's hand.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Suddenly Christopher Robin began to laugh ... and he laughed ... and he laughed ... and he laughed.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: And while he was still laughing--_Crash_ went the Heffalump's head against the tree-root, Smash went the jar, and out came Pooh's head again....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: Then Piglet saw what a Foolish Piglet he had been, and he was so ashamed of himself that he ran straight off home and went to bed with a headache.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: But Christopher Robin and Pooh went home to breakfast together.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "Oh, Bear!" said Christopher Robin. "How I do love you!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
Chapter V: In Which Piglet Meets a Heffalump
saetze.text: "So do I," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.alt: Eeyore looks at his own reflection in a stream in front of a big old tree, ears flopping down; a dragonfly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Eeyore, the old grey Donkey, stood by the side of the stream, and looked at himself in the water.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Pathetic," he said. "That's what it is. Pathetic."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: He turned and walked slowly down the stream for twenty yards, splashed across it, and walked slowly back on the other side.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Then he looked at himself in the water again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "As I thought," he said. "No better from _this_ side. But nobody minds. Nobody cares. Pathetic, that's what it is."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: There was a crackling noise in the bracken behind him, and out came Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Good morning, Eeyore," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Good morning, Pooh Bear," said Eeyore gloomily. "If it _is_ a good morning," he said. "Which I doubt," said he.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Why, what's the matter?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Nothing, Pooh Bear, nothing. We can't all, and some of us don't. That's all there is to it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Can't all _what_?" said Pooh, rubbing his nose.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Gaiety. Song-and-dance. Here we go round the mulberry bush."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Pooh. He thought for a long time, and then asked, "What mulberry bush is that?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Bon-hommy," went on Eeyore gloomily. "French word meaning bonhommy," he explained. "I'm not complaining, but There It Is."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Pooh sat down on a large stone, and tried to think this out.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: It sounded to him like a riddle, and he was never much good at riddles, being a Bear of Very Little Brain.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: So he sang _Cottleston Pie_ instead:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text:
Cottleston, Cottleston, Cottleston Pie,
A fly can't bird, but a bird can fly.
Ask me a riddle and I reply:
"_Cottleston, Cottleston, Cottleston Pie._"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: That was the first verse.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: When he had finished it, Eeyore didn't actually say that he didn't like it, so Pooh very kindly sang the second verse to him:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text:
Cottleston, Cottleston, Cottleston Pie,
A fish can't whistle and neither can I.
Ask me a riddle and I reply:
"_Cottleston, Cottleston, Cottleston Pie_."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Eeyore still said nothing at all, so Pooh hummed the third verse quietly to himself:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text:
Cottleston, Cottleston, Cottleston Pie,
Why does a chicken, I don't know why.
Ask me a riddle and I reply:
"_Cottleston, Cottleston, Cottleston Pie_."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "That's right," said Eeyore. "Sing. Umty-tiddly, umty-too. Here we go gathering Nuts and May. Enjoy yourself."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I am," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Some can," said Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Why, what's the matter?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "_Is_ anything the matter?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "You seem so sad, Eeyore."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Sad? Why should I be sad? It's my birthday. The happiest day of the year."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Your birthday?" said Pooh in great surprise.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Of course it is. Can't you see? Look at all the presents I have had." He waved a foot from side to side. "Look at the birthday cake. Candles and pink sugar."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Pooh looked--first to the right and then to the left.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Presents?" said Pooh. "Birthday cake?" said Pooh. "_Where?_"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Can't you see them?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "No," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Neither can I," said Eeyore. "Joke," he explained. "Ha ha!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Pooh scratched his head, being a little puzzled by all this.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "But is it really your birthday?" he asked.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "It is."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Oh! Well, Many happy returns of the day, Eeyore."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "And many happy returns to you, Pooh Bear."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "But it isn't _my_ birthday."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "No, it's mine."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "But you said 'Many happy returns'----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Well, why not? You don't always want to be miserable on my birthday, do you?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Oh, I see," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "It's bad enough," said Eeyore, almost breaking down, "being miserable myself, what with no presents and no cake and no candles, and no proper notice taken of me at all, but if everybody else is going to be miserable too----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: This was too much for Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Stay there!" he called to Eeyore, as he turned and hurried back home as quick as he could; for he felt that he must get poor Eeyore a present of _some_ sort at once, and he could always think of a proper one afterwards.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Outside his house he found Piglet, jumping up and down trying to reach the knocker.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Hallo, Piglet," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Hallo, Pooh," said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "What are _you_ trying to do?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I was trying to reach the knocker," said Piglet. "I just came round----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Let me do it for you," said Pooh kindly. So he reached up and knocked at the door. "I have just seen Eeyore," he began, "and poor Eeyore is in a Very Sad Condition, because it's his birthday, and nobody has taken any notice of it, and he's very Gloomy--you know what Eeyore is--and there he was, and----What a long time whoever lives here is answering this door." And he knocked again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "But Pooh," said Piglet, "it's your own house!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Pooh. "So it is," he said. "Well, let's go in."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: So in they went.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: The first thing Pooh did was to go to the cupboard to see if he had quite a small jar of honey left; and he had, so he took it down.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I'm giving this to Eeyore," he explained, "as a present. What are _you_ going to give?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Couldn't I give it too?" said Piglet. "From both of us?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "No," said Pooh. "That would _not_ be a good plan."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "All right, then, I'll give him a balloon. I've got one left from my party. I'll go and get it now, shall I?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "That, Piglet, is a _very_ good idea. It is just what Eeyore wants to cheer him up. Nobody can be uncheered with a balloon."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: So off Piglet trotted; and in the other direction went Pooh, with his jar of honey.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: It was a warm day, and he had a long way to go.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: He hadn't gone more than half-way when a sort of funny feeling began to creep all over him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: It began at the tip of his nose and trickled all through him and out at the soles of his feet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: It was just as if somebody inside him were saying, "Now then, Pooh, time for a little something."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Dear, dear," said Pooh, "I didn't know it was as late as that." So he sat down and took the top off his jar of honey. "Lucky I brought this with me," he thought. "Many a bear going out on a warm day like this would never have thought of bringing a little something with him." And he began to eat.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.alt: The bear sits on the ground with his face deep in the honey jar.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Now let me see," he thought, as he took his last lick of the inside of the jar, "where was I going? Ah, yes, Eeyore." He got up slowly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: And then, suddenly, he remembered.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: He had eaten Eeyore's birthday present!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "_Bother!_" said Pooh. "What _shall_ I do? I _must_ give him _something_."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: For a little while he couldn't think of anything.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Then he thought: "Well, it's a very nice pot, even if there's no honey in it, and if I washed it clean, and got somebody to write '_A Happy Birthday_' on it, Eeyore could keep things in it, which might be Useful."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: So, as he was just passing the Hundred Acre Wood, he went inside to call on Owl, who lived there.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Good morning, Owl," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Good morning, Pooh," said Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Many happy returns of Eeyore's birthday," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Oh, is that what it is?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "What are you giving him, Owl?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "What are _you_ giving him, Pooh?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I'm giving him a Useful Pot to Keep Things In, and I wanted to ask you----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Is this it?" said Owl, taking it out of Pooh's paw.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Yes, and I wanted to ask you----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Somebody has been keeping honey in it," said Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "You can keep _anything_ in it," said Pooh earnestly. "It's Very Useful like that. And I wanted to ask you----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "You ought to write '_A Happy Birthday_' on it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "_That_ was what I wanted to ask you," said Pooh. "Because my spelling is Wobbly. It's good spelling but it Wobbles, and the letters get in the wrong places. Would _you_ write 'A Happy Birthday' on it for me?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "It's a nice pot," said Owl, looking at it all round. "Couldn't I give it too? From both of us?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "No," said Pooh. "That would _not_ be a good plan. Now I'll just wash it first, and then you can write on it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Well, he washed the pot out, and dried it, while Owl licked the end of his pencil, and wondered how to spell "birthday."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Can you read, Pooh?" he asked a little anxiously. "There's a notice about knocking and ringing outside my door, which Christopher Robin wrote. Could you read it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Christopher Robin told me what it said, and _then_ I could."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Well, I'll tell you what _this_ says, and then you'll be able to."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: So Owl wrote ... and this is what he wrote:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: HIPY PAPY BTHUTHDTH THUTHDA BTHUTHDY.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Pooh looked on admiringly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I'm just saying 'A Happy Birthday'," said Owl carelessly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "It's a nice long one," said Pooh, very much impressed by it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Well, _actually_, of course, I'm saying 'A Very Happy Birthday with love from Pooh.' Naturally it takes a good deal of pencil to say a long thing like that."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Oh, I see," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: While all this was happening, Piglet had gone back to his own house to get Eeyore's balloon.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: He held it very tightly against himself, so that it shouldn't blow away, and he ran as fast as he could so as to get to Eeyore before Pooh did; for he thought that he would like to be the first one to give a present, just as if he had thought of it without being told by anybody.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: And running along, and thinking how pleased Eeyore would be, he didn't look where he was going ... and suddenly he put his foot in a rabbit hole, and fell down flat on his face.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Piglet lay there, wondering what had happened.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: At first he thought that the whole world had blown up; and then he thought that perhaps only the Forest part of it had; and then he thought that perhaps only _he_ had, and he was now alone in the moon or somewhere, and would never see Christopher Robin or Pooh or Eeyore again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: And then he thought, "Well, even if I'm in the moon, I needn't be face downwards all the time," so he got cautiously up and looked about him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: He was still in the Forest!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Well, that's funny," he thought. "I wonder what that bang was. I couldn't have made such a noise just falling down. And where's my balloon? And what's that small piece of damp rag doing?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: It was the balloon!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Oh, dear!" said Piglet "Oh, dear, oh, dearie, dearie, dear! Well, it's too late now. I can't go back, and I haven't another balloon, and perhaps Eeyore doesn't _like_ balloons so _very_ much."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: So he trotted on, rather sadly now, and down he came to the side of the stream where Eeyore was, and called out to him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Good morning, Eeyore," shouted Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Good morning, Little Piglet," said Eeyore. "If it _is_ a good morning," he said. "Which I doubt," said he. "Not that it matters," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Many happy returns of the day," said Piglet, having now got closer.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Eeyore stopped looking at himself in the stream, and turned to stare at Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Just say that again," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Many hap----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Wait a moment."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Balancing on three legs, he began to bring his fourth leg very cautiously up to his ear.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I did this yesterday," he explained, as he fell down for the third time. "It's quite easy. It's so as I can hear better.... There, that's done it! Now then, what were you saying?" He pushed his ear forward with his hoof.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Many happy returns of the day," said Piglet again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Meaning me?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Of course, Eeyore."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "My birthday?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Yes."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Me having a real birthday?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Yes, Eeyore, and I've brought you a present."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Eeyore took down his right hoof from his right ear, turned round, and with great difficulty put up his left hoof.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I must have that in the other ear," he said. "Now then."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "A present," said Piglet very loudly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Meaning me again?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Yes."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "My birthday still?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Of course, Eeyore."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Me going on having a real birthday?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Yes, Eeyore, and I brought you a balloon."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "_Balloon?_" said Eeyore. "You did say balloon? One of those big coloured things you blow up? Gaiety, song-and-dance, here we are and there we are?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Yes, but I'm afraid--I'm very sorry, Eeyore--but when I was running along to bring it you, I fell down."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Dear, dear, how unlucky! You ran too fast, I expect. You didn't hurt yourself, Little Piglet?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "No, but I--I--oh, Eeyore, I burst the balloon!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: There was a very long silence.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "My balloon?" said Eeyore at last.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Piglet nodded.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "My birthday balloon?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Yes, Eeyore," said Piglet sniffing a little. "Here it is. With--with many happy returns of the day." And he gave Eeyore the small piece of damp rag.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Is this it?" said Eeyore, a little surprised.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Piglet nodded.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "My present?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Piglet nodded again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "The balloon?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Yes."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Thank you, Piglet," said Eeyore. "You don't mind my asking," he went on, "but what colour was this balloon when it--when it _was_ a balloon?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Red."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I just wondered.... Red," he murmured to himself. "My favourite colour.... How big was it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "About as big as me."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I just wondered.... About as big as Piglet," he said to himself sadly. "My favourite size. Well, well."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Piglet felt very miserable, and didn't know what to say.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: He was still opening his mouth to begin something, and then deciding that it wasn't any good saying _that_, when he heard a shout from the other side of the river, and there was Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Many happy returns of the day," called out Pooh, forgetting that he had said it already.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Thank you, Pooh, I'm having them," said Eeyore gloomily.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I've brought you a little present," said Pooh excitedly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I've had it," said Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: Pooh had now splashed across the stream to Eeyore, and Piglet was sitting a little way off, his head in his paws, snuffling to himself.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "It's a Useful Pot," said Pooh. "Here it is. And it's got 'A Very Happy Birthday with love from Pooh' written on it. That's what all that writing is. And it's for putting things in. There!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: When Eeyore saw the pot, he became quite excited.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Why!" he said. "I believe my Balloon will just go into that Pot!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Oh, no, Eeyore," said Pooh. "Balloons are much too big to go into Pots. What you do with a balloon is, you hold the ballon----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Not mine," said Eeyore proudly. "Look, Piglet!" And as Piglet looked sorrowfully round, Eeyore picked the balloon up with his teeth, and placed it carefully in the pot; picked it out and put it on the ground; and then picked it up again and put it carefully back.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "So it does!" said Pooh. "It goes in!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "So it does!" said Piglet. "And it comes out!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Doesn't it?" said Eeyore. "It goes in and out like anything."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I'm very glad," said Pooh happily, "that I thought of giving you a Useful Pot to put things in."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I'm very glad," said Piglet happily, "that I thought of giving you Something to put in a Useful Pot."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: But Eeyore wasn't listening.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: He was taking the balloon out, and putting it back again, as happy as could be....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.alt: Eeyore happily puts the burst balloon into the empty jar and takes it out again, tail perked up; the bear and Piglet walk away hand in hand.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "And didn't _I_ give him anything?" asked Christopher Robin sadly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Of course you did," I said. "You gave him--don't you remember--a little--a little----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "I gave him a box of paints to paint things with."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "That was it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Why didn't I give it to him in the morning?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "You were so busy getting his party ready for him. He had a cake with icing on the top, and three candles, and his name in pink sugar, and----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
Chapter VI: In Which Eeyore Has a Birthday and Gets Two Presents
saetze.text: "Yes, _I_ remember," said Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Nobody seemed to know where they came from, but there they were in the Forest: Kanga and Baby Roo.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: When Pooh asked Christopher Robin, "How did they come here?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Christopher Robin said, "In the Usual Way, if you know what I mean, Pooh," and Pooh, who didn't, said "Oh!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Then he nodded his head twice and said, "In the Usual Way. Ah!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Then he went to call upon his friend Piglet to see what _he_ thought about it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: And at Piglet's house he found Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: So they all talked about it together.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "What I don't like about it is this," said Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Here are we--you, Pooh, and you, Piglet, and Me--and suddenly----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "And Eeyore," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "And Eeyore--and then suddenly----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "And Owl," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "And Owl--and then all of a sudden----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Oh, and Eeyore," said Pooh. "I was forgetting _him_."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Here--we--are," said Rabbit very slowly and carefully, "all--of--us, and then, suddenly, we wake up one morning and, what do we find? We find a Strange Animal among us. An animal of whom we have never even heard before! An animal who carries her family about with her in her pocket! Suppose _I_ carried _my_ family about with me in _my_ pocket, how many pockets should I want?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Sixteen," said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Seventeen, isn't it?" said Rabbit. "And one more for a handkerchief--that's eighteen. Eighteen pockets in one suit! I haven't time."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: There was a long and thoughtful silence ... and then Pooh, who had been frowning very hard for some minutes, said: "_I_ make it fifteen."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "What?" said Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Fifteen."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Fifteen what?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Your family."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "What about them?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Pooh rubbed his nose and said that he thought Rabbit had been talking about his family.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Did I?" said Rabbit carelessly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Yes, you said----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Never mind, Pooh," said Piglet impatiently.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "The question is, What are we to do about Kanga?"
