saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Oh, I see," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "The best way," said Rabbit, "would be this. The best way would be to steal Baby Roo and hide him, and then when Kanga says, 'Where's Baby Roo?' we say, '_Aha!_' "

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "_Aha!_" said Pooh, practising. "_Aha! Aha!_ ... Of course," he went on, "we could say 'Aha!' even if we hadn't stolen Baby Roo."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Pooh," said Rabbit kindly, "you haven't any brain."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "I know," said Pooh humbly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "We say '_Aha!_' so that Kanga knows that _we_ know where Baby Roo is. '_Aha!_' means 'We'll tell you where Baby Roo is, if you promise to go away from the Forest and never come back.' Now don't talk while I think."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Pooh went into a corner and tried saying 'Aha!' in that sort of voice.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Sometimes it seemed to him that it did mean what Rabbit said, and sometimes it seemed to him that it didn't.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "I suppose it's just practice," he thought. "I wonder if Kanga will have to practise too so as to understand it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "There's just one thing," said Piglet, fidgeting a bit. "I was talking to Christopher Robin, and he said that a Kanga was Generally Regarded as One of the Fiercer Animals. I am not frightened of Fierce Animals in the ordinary way, but it is well known that, if One of the Fiercer Animals is Deprived of Its Young, it becomes as fierce as Two of the Fiercer Animals. In which case '_Aha!_' is perhaps a _foolish_ thing to say."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Piglet," said Rabbit, taking out a pencil, and licking the end of it, "you haven't any pluck."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "It is hard to be brave," said Piglet, sniffing slightly, "when you're only a Very Small Animal."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Rabbit, who had begun to write very busily, looked up and said:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "It is because you are a very small animal that you will be Useful in the adventure before us."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Piglet was so excited at the idea of being Useful, that he forgot to be frightened any more, and when Rabbit went on to say that Kangas were only Fierce during the winter months, being at other times of an Affectionate Disposition, he could hardly sit still, he was so eager to begin being useful at once.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "What about me?" said Pooh sadly. "I suppose _I_ shan't be useful?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Never mind, Pooh," said Piglet comfortingly. "Another time perhaps."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Without Pooh," said Rabbit solemnly as he sharpened his pencil, "the adventure would be impossible."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Piglet, and tried not to look disappointed.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: But Pooh went into a corner of the room and said proudly to himself, "Impossible without Me! _That_ sort of Bear."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Now listen all of you," said Rabbit when he had finished writing, and Pooh and Piglet sat listening very eagerly with their mouths open. This was what Rabbit read out:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 1. _General Remarks._ Kanga runs faster than any of Us, even Me.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 2. _More General Remarks._ Kanga never takes her eye off Baby Roo, except when he's safely buttoned up in her pocket.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 3. _Therefore._ If we are to capture Baby Roo, we must get a Long Start, because Kanga runs faster than any of Us, even Me. (_See_ 1.)

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 4. _A Thought._ If Roo had jumped out of Kanga's pocket and Piglet had jumped in, Kanga wouldn't know the difference, because Piglet is a Very Small Animal.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 5. Like Roo.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 6. But Kanga would have to be looking the other way first, so as not to see Piglet jumping in.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 7. See 2.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 8. _Another Thought._ But if Pooh was talking to her very excitedly, she _might_ look the other way for a moment.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 9. And then I could run away with Roo.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 10. Quickly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: 11. _And Kanga wouldn't discover the difference until Afterwards._

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Well, Rabbit read this out proudly, and for a little while after he had read it nobody said anything.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: And then Piglet, who had been opening and shutting his mouth without making any noise, managed to say very huskily:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "And--Afterwards?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "How do you mean?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "When Kanga _does_ Discover the Difference?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Then we all say '_Aha!_"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "All three of us?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Yes."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Oh!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Why, what's the trouble, Piglet?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Nothing," said Piglet, "as long as _we all three_ say it. As long as we all three say it," said Piglet, "I don't mind," he said, "but I shouldn't care to say '_Aha!_' by myself. It wouldn't sound _nearly_ so well. By the way," he said, "you _are_ quite sure about what you said about the winter months?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "The winter months?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Yes, only being Fierce in the Winter Months."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Oh, yes, yes, that's all right. Well, Pooh? You see what you have to do?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "No," said Pooh Bear. "Not yet," he said. "What _do_ I do?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Well, you just have to talk very hard to Kanga so as she doesn't notice anything."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Oh! What about?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Anything you like."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "You mean like telling her a little bit of poetry or something?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "That's it," said Rabbit. "Splendid. Now come along."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: So they all went out to look for Kanga.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Kanga and Roo were spending a quiet afternoon in a sandy part of the Forest.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Baby Roo was practising very small jumps in the sand, and falling down mouse-holes and climbing out of them, and Kanga was fidgeting about and saying "Just one more jump, dear, and then we must go home."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: And at that moment who should come stumping up the hill but Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Good afternoon, Kanga."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Good afternoon, Pooh."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Look at me jumping," squeaked Roo, and fell into another mouse-hole.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Hallo, Roo, my little fellow!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "We were just going home," said Kanga. "Good afternoon, Rabbit. Good afternoon, Piglet."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Rabbit and Piglet, who had now come up from the other side of the hill, said "Good afternoon," and "Hallo, Roo," and Roo asked them to look at him jumping, so they stayed and looked.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: And Kanga looked too....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Oh, Kanga," said Pooh, after Rabbit had winked at him twice, "I don't know if you are interested in Poetry at all?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Hardly at all," said Kanga.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Roo, dear, just one more jump and then we must go home."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: There was a short silence while Roo fell down another mouse-hole.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Go on," said Rabbit in a loud whisper behind his paw.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Talking of Poetry," said Pooh, "I made up a little piece as I was coming along. It went like this. Er--now let me see----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Fancy!" said Kanga. "Now Roo, dear----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "You'll like this piece of poetry," said Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "You'll love it," said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "You must listen very carefully," said Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "So as not to miss any of it," said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Oh, yes," said Kanga, but she still looked at Baby Roo.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "_How_ did it go, Pooh?" said Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Pooh gave a little cough and began.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text:
On Monday, when the sun is hot
I wonder to myself a lot:
"Now is it true, or is it not,
"That what is which and which is what?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text:
On Tuesday, when it hails and snows,
The feeling on me grows and grows
That hardly anybody knows
If those are these or these are those.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text:
On Wednesday, when the sky is blue,
And I have nothing else to do,
I sometimes wonder if it's true
That who is what and what is who.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text:
On Thursday, when it starts to freeze
And hoar-frost twinkles on the trees,
How very readily one sees
That these are whose--but whose are these?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: On Friday----

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Yes, it is, isn't it?" said Kanga, not waiting to hear what happened on Friday. "Just one more jump, Roo, dear, and then we really _must_ be going."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Rabbit gave Pooh a hurrying-up sort of nudge.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Talking of Poetry," said Pooh quickly, "have you ever noticed that tree right over there?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Where?" said Kanga. "Now, Roo----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Right over there," said Pooh, pointing behind Kanga's back.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "No," said Kanga. "Now jump in, Roo, dear, and we'll go home."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "You ought to look at that tree right over there," said Rabbit. "Shall I lift you in, Roo?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: And he picked up Roo in his paws.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "I can see a bird in it from here," said Pooh. "Or is it a fish?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "You ought to see that bird from here," said Rabbit. "Unless it's a fish."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "It isn't a fish, it's a bird," said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "So it is," said Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Is it a starling or a blackbird?" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "That's the whole question," said Rabbit. "Is it a blackbird or a starling?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: And then at last Kanga did turn her head to look.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: And the moment that her head was turned, Rabbit said in a loud voice "In you go, Roo!" and in jumped Piglet into Kanga's pocket, and off scampered Rabbit, with Roo in his paws, as fast as he could.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Why, where's Rabbit?" said Kanga, turning round again. "Are you all right, Roo, dear?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Piglet made a squeaky Roo-noise from the bottom of Kanga's pocket.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Rabbit had to go away," said Pooh. "I think he thought of something he had to go and see about suddenly."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "And Piglet?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "I think Piglet thought of something at the same time. Suddenly."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Well, we must be getting home," said Kanga. "Good-bye, Pooh."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: And in three large jumps she was gone.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Pooh looked after her as she went.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "I wish I could jump like that," he thought. "Some can and some can't. That's how it is."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath

Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Now then, Roo, dear," she said, as she took Piglet out of her pocket. "Bed-time."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "_Aha!_" said Piglet, as well as he could after his Terrifying Journey.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Bath first," said Kanga in a cheerful voice.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: But the others weren't there.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Rabbit was playing with Baby Roo in his own house, and feeling more fond of him every minute, and Pooh, who had decided to be a Kanga, was still at the sandy place on the top of the Forest, practising jumps.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "I am not at all sure," said Kanga in a thoughtful voice, "that it wouldn't be a good idea to have a _cold_ bath this evening. Would you like that, Roo, dear?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Piglet, who had never been really fond of baths, shuddered a long indignant shudder, and said in as brave a voice as he could:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Kanga, I see that the time has come to spleak painly."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Funny little Roo," said Kanga, as she got the bath-water ready.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "I am _not_ Roo," said Piglet loudly. "I am Piglet!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Yes, dear, yes," said Kanga soothingly. "And imitating Piglet's voice too! So clever of him," she went on, as she took a large bar of yellow soap out of the cupboard. "What _will_ he be doing next?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Can't you _see_?" shouted Piglet. "Haven't you got _eyes_? _Look_ at me!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "I _am_ looking, Roo, dear," said Kanga rather severely. "And you know what I told you yesterday about making faces. If you go on making faces like Piglet's, you will grow up to _look_ like Piglet--and _then_ think how sorry you will be. Now then, into the bath, and don't let me have to speak to you about it again."

saetze.text: Before he knew where he was, Piglet was in the bath, and Kanga was scrubbing him firmly with a large lathery flannel.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Ow!" cried Piglet. "Let me out! I'm Piglet!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Don't open the mouth, dear, or the soap goes in," said Kanga. "There! What did I tell you?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "You--you--you did it on purpose," spluttered Piglet, as soon as he could speak again ... and then accidentally had another mouthful of lathery flannel.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "That's right, dear, don't say anything," said Kanga, and in another minute Piglet was out of the bath, and being rubbed dry with a towel.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Now," said Kanga, "there's your medicine, and then bed."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "W-w-what medicine?" said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "To make you grow big and strong, dear. You don't want to grow up small and weak like Piglet, do you? Well, then!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: At that moment there was a knock at the door.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Come in," said Kanga, and in came Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Christopher Robin, Christopher Robin!" cried Piglet. "Tell Kanga who I am! She keeps saying I'm Roo. I'm _not_ Roo, am I?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Christopher Robin looked at him very carefully, and shook his head.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "You can't be Roo," he said, "because I've just seen Roo playing in Rabbit's house."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Well!" said Kanga. "Fancy that! Fancy my making a mistake like that."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "There you are!" said Piglet. "I told you so. I'm Piglet."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Christopher Robin shook his head again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Oh, you're not Piglet," he said. "I know Piglet well, and he's _quite_ a different colour."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Piglet began to say that this was because he had just had a bath, and then he thought that perhaps he wouldn't say that, and as he opened his mouth to say something else, Kanga slipped the medicine spoon in, and then patted him on the back and told him that it was really quite a nice taste when you got used to it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "I knew it wasn't Piglet," said Kanga. "I wonder who it can be."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "Perhaps it's some relation of Pooh's," said Christopher Robin. "What about a nephew or an uncle or something?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Kanga agreed that this was probably what it was, and said that they would have to call it by some name.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: "I shall call it Pootel," said Christopher Robin. "Henry Pootel for short."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: And just when it was decided, Henry Pootel wriggled out of Kanga's arms and jumped to the ground.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: To his great joy Christopher Robin had left the door open.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: Never had Henry Pootel Piglet run so fast as he ran then, and he didn't stop running until he had got quite close to his house.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
saetze.text: But when he was a hundred yards away he stopped running, and rolled the rest of the way home, so as to get his own nice comfortable colour again....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath
Chapter VII: In Which Kanga and Baby Roo Come to the Forest, and Piglet Has a Bath

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: One fine day Pooh had stumped up to the top of the Forest to see if his friend Christopher Robin was interested in Bears at all.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: At breakfast that morning (a simple meal of marmalade spread lightly over a honeycomb or two) he had suddenly thought of a new song.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: It began like this:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "_Sing Ho! for the life of a Bear._"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: When he had got as far as this, he scratched his head, and thought to himself "That's a very good start for a song, but what about the second line?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: He tried singing "Ho," two or three times, but it didn't seem to help.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Perhaps it would be better," he thought, "if I sang Hi for the life of a Bear."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: So he sang it ... but it wasn't.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Very well, then," he said, "I shall sing that first line twice, and perhaps if I sing it very quickly, I shall find myself singing the third and fourth lines before I have time to think of them, and that will be a Good Song.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Now then:"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text:
Sing Ho! for the life of a Bear!
Sing Ho! for the life of a Bear!
I don't much mind if it rains or snows,
'Cos I've got a lot of honey on my nice new nose,
I don't much care if it snows or thaws,
'Cos I've got a lot of honey on my nice clean paws!
Sing Ho! for a Bear!
Sing Ho! for a Pooh!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: So he turned it into a hum instead.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Christopher Robin was sitting outside his door, putting on his Big Boots.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: As soon as he saw the Big Boots, Pooh knew that an Adventure was going to happen, and he brushed the honey off his nose with the back of his paw, and spruced himself up as well as he could, so as to look Ready for Anything.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "That's bad," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "And that's that," said Pooh. "What do we do next?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Expedition, silly old Bear. It's got an 'x' in it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Pooh. "I know." But he didn't really.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "We're going to discover the North Pole."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Pooh again. "What _is_ the North Pole?" he asked.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "It's just a thing you discover," said Christopher Robin carelessly, not being quite sure himself.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Oh! I see," said Pooh. "Are bears any good at discovering it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Bring what?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: The first person he met was Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Hallo, Rabbit," he said, "is that you?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Let's pretend it isn't," said Rabbit, "and see what happens."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I've got a message for you."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I'll give it to him."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "We're all going on an Expotition with Christopher Robin!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "What is it when we're on it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "A sort of boat, I think," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Oh! that sort."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Yes. And we're going to discover a Pole or something. Or was it a Mole? Anyhow we're going to discover it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "We are, are we?" said Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Yes. And we've got to bring Pro--things to eat with us. In case we want to eat them. Now I'm going down to Piglet's. Tell Kanga, will you?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: The Piglet was sitting on the ground at the door of his house blowing happily at a dandelion, and wondering whether it would be this year, next year, sometime or never.

Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Oh! Piglet," said Pooh excitedly, "we're going on an Expotition, all of us, with things to eat. To discover something."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "To discover what?" said Piglet anxiously.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "What I say," said Eeyore, "is that it's unsettling. I didn't want to come on this Expo--what Pooh said. I only came to oblige. But here I am; and if I am the end of the Expo--what we're talking about--then let me _be_ the end. But if, every time I want to sit down for a little rest, I have to brush away half a dozen of Rabbit's smaller friends-and-relations first, then this isn't an Expo--whatever it is--at all, it's simply a Confused Noise. That's what _I_ say."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.alt: Christopher Robin in big boots shouts to the front of a long line: Rabbit, the bear, Piglet, Owl, Kanga and baby Roo.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I see what Eeyore means," said Owl. "If you ask me----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I'm not asking anybody," said Eeyore. "I'm just telling everybody. We can look for the North Pole, or we can play 'Here we go gathering Nuts and May' with the end part of an ant's nest. It's all the same to me."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: There was a shout from the top of the line.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Come on!" called Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Come on!" called Pooh and Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Come on!" called Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "We're starting," said Rabbit. "I must go." And he hurried off to the front of the Expotition with Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "All right," said Eeyore. "We're going. Only Don't Blame Me."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: So off they all went to discover the Pole.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: And as they walked, they chattered to each other of this and that, all except Pooh, who was making up a song.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "This is the first verse," he said to Piglet, when he was ready with it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "First verse of what?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "My song."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "What song?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "This one."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Which one?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Well, if you listen, Piglet, you'll hear it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "How do you know I'm not listening?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Pooh couldn't answer that one, so he began to sing.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text:
They all went off to discover the Pole,
Owl and Piglet and Rabbit and all;
It's a Thing you Discover, as I've been tole
By Owl and Piglet and Rabbit and all.
Eeyore, Christopher Robin and Pooh
And Rabbit's relations all went too--
And where the Pole was none of them knew....
Sing Hey! for Owl and Rabbit and all!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Hush!" said Christopher Robin turning round to Pooh, "we're just coming to a Dangerous Place."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Hush!" said Pooh turning round quickly to Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Hush!" said Piglet to Kanga.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Hush!" said Kanga to Owl, while Roo said "Hush!" several times to himself very quietly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Hush!" said Owl to Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "_Hush!_", said Eeyore in a terrible voice to all Rabbit's friends-and-relations, and "Hush!" they said hastily to each other all down the line, until it got to the last one of all.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: And the last and smallest friend-and-relation was so upset to find that the whole Expotition was saying "Hush!" to _him_, that he buried himself head downwards in a crack in the ground, and stayed there for two days until the danger was over, and then went home in a great hurry, and lived quietly with his Aunt ever-afterwards.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: His name was Alexander Beetle.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: They had come to a stream which twisted and tumbled between high rocky banks, and Christopher Robin saw at once how dangerous it was.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "It's just the place," he explained, "for an Ambush."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "What sort of bush?" whispered Pooh to Piglet. "A gorse-bush?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "My dear Pooh," said Owl in his superior way, "don't you know what an Ambush is?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Owl," said Piglet, looking round at him severely, "Pooh's whisper was a perfectly private whisper, and there was no need----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "An Ambush," said Owl, "is a sort of Surprise."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "So is a gorse-bush sometimes," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "An Ambush, as I was about to explain to Pooh," said Piglet, "is a sort of Surprise."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "If people jump out at you suddenly, that's an Ambush," said Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "It's an Ambush, Pooh, when people jump at you suddenly," explained Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Pooh, who now knew what an Ambush was, said that a gorse-bush had sprung at him suddenly one day when he fell off a tree, and he had taken six days to get all the prickles out of himself.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "We are not _talking_ about gorse-bushes," said Owl a little crossly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I am," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: They were climbing very cautiously up the stream now, going from rock to rock, and after they had gone a little way they came to a place where the banks widened out at each side, so that on each side of the water there was a level strip of grass on which they could sit down and rest.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: As soon as he saw this, Christopher Robin called "Halt!" and they all sat down and rested.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I think," said Christopher Robin, "that we ought to eat all our Provisions now, so that we shan't have so much to carry."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Eat all our what?" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "All that we've brought," said Piglet, getting to work.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "That's a good idea," said Pooh, and he got to work too.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Have you all got something?" asked Christopher Robin with his mouth full.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "All except me," said Eeyore. "As Usual." He looked round at them in his melancholy way. "I suppose none of you are sitting on a thistle by any chance?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I believe I am," said Pooh. "Ow!" He got up, and looked behind him. "Yes, I was. I thought so."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Thank you, Pooh. If you've quite finished with it." He moved across to Pooh's place, and began to eat.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "It don't do them any Good, you know, sitting on them," he went on, as he looked up munching. "Takes all the Life out of them. Remember that another time, all of you. A little Consideration, a little Thought for Others, makes all the difference."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: As soon as he had finished his lunch Christopher Robin whispered to Rabbit, and Rabbit said "Yes, yes, of course," and they walked a little way up the stream together.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I didn't want the others to hear," said Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Quite so," said Rabbit, looking important.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "It's--I wondered--It's only--Rabbit, I suppose _you_ don't know, What does the North Pole _look_ like?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Well," said Rabbit, stroking his whiskers. "Now you're asking me."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I did know once, only I've sort of forgotten," said Christopher Robin carelessly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "It's a funny thing," said Rabbit, "but I've sort of forgotten too, although I did know _once_."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I suppose it's just a pole stuck in the ground?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Sure to be a pole," said Rabbit, "because of calling it a pole, and if it's a pole, well, I should think it would be sticking in the ground, shouldn't you, because there'd be nowhere else to stick it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Yes, that's what I thought."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "The only thing," said Rabbit, "is, _where is it sticking_?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "That's what we're looking for," said Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: They went back to the others.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Piglet was lying on his back, sleeping peacefully.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Roo was washing his face and paws in the stream, while Kanga explained to everybody proudly that this was the first time he had ever washed his face himself, and Owl was telling Kanga an Interesting Anecdote full of long words like Encyclop√¶dia and Rhododendron to which Kanga wasn't listening.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I don't hold with all this washing," grumbled Eeyore. "This modern Behind-the-ears nonsense. What do _you_ think, Pooh?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Well," said Pooh, "_I_ think----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: But we shall never know what Pooh thought, for there came a sudden squeak from Roo, a splash, and a loud cry of alarm from Kanga.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "So much for _washing_," said Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Roo's fallen in!" cried Rabbit, and he and Christopher Robin came rushing down to the rescue.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Look at me swimming!" squeaked Roo from the middle of his pool, and was hurried down a waterfall into the next pool.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Are you all right, Roo dear?" called Kanga anxiously.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Yes!" said Roo. "Look at me sw----" and down he went over the next waterfall into another pool.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Everybody was doing something to help.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Piglet, wide awake suddenly, was jumping up and down and making "Oo, I say" noises; Owl was explaining that in a case of Sudden and Temporary Immersion the Important Thing was to keep the Head Above Water; Kanga was jumping along the bank, saying "Are you _sure_ you're all right, Roo dear?" to which Roo, from whatever pool he was in at the moment, was answering "Look at me swimming!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Eeyore had turned round and hung his tail over the first pool into which Roo fell, and with his back to the accident was grumbling quietly to himself, and saying, "All this washing; but catch on to my tail, little Roo, and you'll be all right"; and, Christopher Robin and Rabbit came hurrying past Eeyore, and were calling out to the others in front of them.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "All right, Roo, I'm coming," called Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Get something across the stream lower down, some of you fellows," called Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: But Pooh was getting something.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Two pools below Roo he was standing with a long pole in his paws, and Kanga came up and took one end of it, and between them they held it across the lower part of the pool; and Roo, still bubbling proudly, "Look at me swimming," drifted up against it, and climbed out.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.alt: The bear holds a long pole across a stream; Roo climbs out; Kanga opens her arms; Owl spreads his wings.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Did you see me swimming?" squeaked Roo excitedly, while Kanga scolded him and rubbed him down. "Pooh, did you see me swimming? That's called swimming, what I was doing. Rabbit, did you see what I was doing? Swimming. Hallo, Piglet! I say, Piglet! What do you think I was doing! Swimming! Christopher Robin, did you see me----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: But Christopher Robin wasn't listening.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: He was looking at Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Pooh," he said, "where did you find that pole?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Pooh looked at the pole in his hands.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I just found it," he said. "I thought it ought to be useful. I just picked it up."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Pooh," said Christopher Robin solemnly, "the Expedition is over. You have found the North Pole!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Eeyore was sitting with his tail in the water when they all got back to him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Tell Roo to be quick, somebody," he said. "My tail's getting cold. I don't want to mention it, but I just mention it. I don't want to complain but there it is. My tail's cold."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Here I am!" squeaked Roo.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Oh, there you are."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Did you see me swimming?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Eeyore took his tail out of the water, and swished it from side to side.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "As I expected," he said. "Lost all feeling. Numbed it. That's what it's done. Numbed it. Well, as long as nobody minds, I suppose it's all right."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Poor old Eeyore. I'll dry it for you," said Christopher Robin, and he took out his handkerchief and rubbed it up.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Thank you, Christopher Robin. You're the only one who seems to understand about tails. They don't think--that's what the matter with some of these others. They've no imagination. A tail isn't a tail to _them_, it's just a Little Bit Extra at the back."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Never mind, Eeyore," said Christopher Robin, rubbing his hardest. "Is _that_ better?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "It's feeling more like a tail perhaps. It Belongs again, if you know what I mean."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Hullo, Eeyore," said Pooh, coming up to them with his pole.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Hullo, Pooh. Thank you for asking, but I shall be able to use it again in a day or two."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Use what?" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "What we are talking about."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "I wasn't talking about anything," said Pooh, looking puzzled.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "My mistake again. I thought you were saying how sorry you were about my tail, being all numb, and could you do anything to help?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "No," said Pooh. "That wasn't me," he said. He thought for a little and then suggested helpfully, "Perhaps it was somebody else."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Well, thank him for me when you see him."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Pooh looked anxiously at Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Pooh's found the North Pole," said Christopher Robin. "Isn't that lovely?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Pooh looked modestly down.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Is that it?" said Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Yes," said Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Is that what we were looking for?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Yes," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Eeyore. "Well, anyhow--it didn't rain," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: They stuck the pole in the ground, and Christopher Robin tied a message on to it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text:
NORTH POLE

DISCOVERED BY POOH

POOH FOUND IT.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: Then they all went home again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: And I think, but I am not quite sure, that Roo had a hot bath and went straight to bed.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter VIII: In Which Christopher Robin Leads an Expotition to the North Pole
saetze.text: But Pooh went back to his own house, and feeling very proud of what he had done, had a little something to revive himself.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It rained and it rained and it rained.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Piglet told himself that never in all his life, and _he_ was goodness knows _how_ old--three, was it, or four?--never had he seen so much rain.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Days and days and days.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "If only," he thought, as he looked out of the window, "I had been in Pooh's house, or Christopher Robin's house, or Rabbit's house when it began to rain, then I should have had Company all this time, instead of being here all alone, with nothing to do except wonder when it will stop."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And he imagined himself with Pooh, saying, "Did you ever see such rain, Pooh?" and Pooh saying, "Isn't it _awful_, Piglet?" and Piglet saying, "I wonder how it is over Christopher Robin's way" and Pooh saying, "I should think poor old Rabbit is about flooded out by this time."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It would have been jolly to talk like this, and really, it wasn't much good having anything exciting like floods, if you couldn't share them with somebody.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: For it was rather exciting.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: The little dry ditches in which Piglet had nosed about so often had become streams, the little streams across which he had splashed were rivers, and the river, between whose steep banks they had played so happily, had sprawled out of its own bed and was taking up so much room everywhere, that Piglet was beginning to wonder whether it would be coming into _his_ bed soon.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "It's a little Anxious," he said to himself, "to be a Very Small Animal Entirely Surrounded by Water.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Christopher Robin and Pooh could escape by Climbing Trees, and Kanga could escape by Jumping, and Rabbit could escape by Burrowing, and Owl could escape by Flying, and Eeyore could escape by--by Making a Loud Noise Until Rescued, and here am I, surrounded by water and I can't do _anything_."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It went on raining, and every day the water got a little higher, until now it was nearly up to Piglet's window ... and still he hadn't done anything.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.alt: Piglet looks out of a window of his house in a huge tree; rain pours down and floodwater swirls around the trunk.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "There's Pooh," he thought to himself.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Pooh hasn't much Brain, but he never comes to any harm.
