saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He does silly things and they turn out right.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: There's Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Owl hasn't exactly got Brain, but he Knows Things.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He would know the Right Thing to Do when Surrounded by Water.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: There's Rabbit.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He hasn't Learnt in Books, but he can always Think of a Clever Plan.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: There's Kanga.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: She isn't Clever, Kanga isn't, but she would be so anxious about Roo that she would do a Good Thing to Do without thinking about It.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And then there's Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And Eeyore is so miserable anyhow that he wouldn't mind about this.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: But I wonder what Christopher Robin would do?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Then suddenly he remembered a story which Christopher Robin had told him about a man on a desert island who had written something in a bottle and thrown it in the sea; and Piglet thought that if he wrote something in a bottle and threw it in the water, perhaps somebody would come and rescue _him_!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He left the window and began to search his house, all of it that wasn't under water, and at last he found a pencil and a small piece of dry paper, and a bottle with a cork to it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And he wrote on one side of the paper:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: HELP! PIGLET (ME)

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: and on the other side:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: IT'S ME PIGLET, HELP HELP.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Then he put the paper in the bottle, and he corked the bottle up as tightly as he could, and he leant out of his window as far as he could lean without falling in, and he threw the bottle as far as he could throw--_splash!_--and in a little while it bobbed up again on the water; and he watched it floating slowly away in the distance, until his eyes ached with looking, and sometimes he thought it was the bottle, and sometimes he thought it was just a ripple on the water which he was following, and then suddenly he knew that he would never see it again and that he had done all that he could do to save himself.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "So now," he thought, "somebody else will have to do something, and I hope they will do it soon, because if they don't I shall have to swim, which I can't, so I hope they do it soon."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And then he gave a very long sigh and said, "I wish Pooh were here.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It's so much more friendly with two."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: When the rain began Pooh was asleep.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It rained, and it rained, and it rained, and he slept and he slept and he slept.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He had had a tiring day.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: You remember how he discovered the North Pole; well, he was so proud of this that he asked Christopher Robin if there were any other Poles such as a Bear of Little Brain might discover.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "There's a South Pole," said Christopher Robin, "and I expect there's an East Pole and a West Pole, though people don't like talking about them."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Pooh was very excited when he heard this, and suggested that they should have an Expotition to discover the East Pole, but Christopher Robin had thought of something else to do with Kanga; so Pooh went out to discover the East Pole by himself.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Whether he discovered it or not, I forget; but he was so tired when he got home that, in the very middle of his supper, after he had been eating for little more than half-an-hour, he fell fast asleep in his chair, and slept and slept and slept.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Then suddenly he was dreaming.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He was at the East Pole, and it was a very cold pole with the coldest sort of snow and ice all over it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He had found a bee-hive to sleep in, but there wasn't room for his legs, so he had left them outside.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And Wild Woozles, such as inhabit the East Pole, came and nibbled all the fur off his legs to make nests for their Young.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And the more they nibbled, the colder his legs got, until suddenly he woke up with an _Ow!_--and there he was, sitting in his chair with his feet in the water, and water all round him!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He splashed to his door and looked out....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "This is Serious," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "I must have an Escape."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: So he took his largest pot of honey and escaped with it to a broad branch of his tree, well above the water, and then he climbed down again and escaped with another pot ... and when the whole Escape was finished, there was Pooh sitting on his branch, dangling his legs, and there, beside him, were ten pots of honey....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Two days later, there was Pooh, sitting on his branch, dangling his legs, and there, beside him, were four pots of honey....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Three days later, there was Pooh, sitting on his branch, dangling his legs, and there beside him, was one pot of honey.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Four days later, there was Pooh ...

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And it was on the morning of the fourth day that Piglet's bottle came floating past him, and with one loud cry of "Honey!" Pooh plunged into the water, seized the bottle, and struggled back to his tree again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Bother!" said Pooh, as he opened it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "All that wet for nothing.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: What's that bit of paper doing?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He took it out and looked at it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "It's a Missage," he said to himself, "that's what it is.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And that letter is a 'P,' and so is that, and so is that, and 'P' means 'Pooh,' so it's a very important Missage to me, and I can't read it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: I must find Christopher Robin or Owl or Piglet, one of those Clever Readers who can read things, and they will tell me what this missage means.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Only I can't swim.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Bother!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Then he had an idea, and I think that for a Bear of Very Little Brain, it was a good idea.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He said to himself:

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "If a bottle can float, then a jar can float, and if a jar floats, I can sit on the top of it, if it's a very big jar."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: So he took his biggest jar, and corked it up.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "All boats have to have a name," he said, "so I shall call mine _The Floating Bear_."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And with these words he dropped his boat into the water and jumped in after it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: For a little while Pooh and _The Floating Bear_ were uncertain as to which of them was meant to be on the top, but after trying one or two different positions, they settled down with _The Floating Bear_ underneath and Pooh triumphantly astride it, paddling vigorously with his feet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Christopher Robin lived at the very top of the Forest.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It rained, and it rained, and it rained, but the water couldn't come up to _his_ house.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It was rather jolly to look down into the valleys and see the water all round him, but it rained so hard that he stayed indoors most of the time, and thought about things.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Every morning he went out with his umbrella and put a stick in the place where the water came up to, and every next morning he went out and couldn't see his stick any more, so he put another stick in the place where the water came up to, and then he walked home again, and each morning he had a shorter way to walk than he had had the morning before.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: On the morning of the fifth day he saw the water all round him, and knew that for the first time in his life he was on a real island.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Which was very exciting.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It was on this morning that Owl came flying over the water to say "How do you do," to his friend Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "I say, Owl," said Christopher Robin, "isn't this fun?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: I'm on an island!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "The atmospheric conditions have been very unfavourable lately," said Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "The what?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "It has been raining," explained Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Yes," said Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "It has."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "The flood-level has reached an unprecedented height."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "The who?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "There's a lot of water about," explained Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Yes," said Christopher Robin, "there is."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "However, the prospects are rapidly becoming more favourable.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: At any moment----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Have you seen Pooh?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "No.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: At any moment----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "I hope he's all right," said Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "I've been wondering about him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: I expect Piglet's with him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Do you think they're all right, Owl?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "I expect so.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: You see, at any moment----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Do go and see, Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Because Pooh hasn't got very much brain, and he might do something silly, and I do love him so, Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Do you see, Owl?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "That's all right," said Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "I'll go.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Back directly."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And he flew off.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: In a little while he was back again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Pooh isn't there," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Not there?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Has _been_ there.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He's been sitting on a branch of his tree outside his house with nine pots of honey.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: But he isn't there now."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Oh, Pooh!" cried Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Where _are_ you?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Here I am," said a growly voice behind him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Pooh!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: They rushed into each other's arms.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "How did you get here, Pooh?" asked Christopher Robin, when he was ready to talk again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "On my boat," said Pooh proudly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "I had a Very Important Missage sent me in a bottle, and owing to having got some water in my eyes, I couldn't read it, so I brought it to you.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: On my boat."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.alt: The bear rides astride his empty floating honey jar out of the water; it is still raining.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: With these proud words he gave Christopher Robin the missage.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "But it's from Piglet!" cried Christopher Robin when he had read it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Isn't there anything about Pooh in it?" asked Bear, looking over his shoulder.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Christopher Robin read the message aloud.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Oh, are those 'P's' piglets?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: I thought they were poohs."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "We must rescue him at once!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: I thought he was with _you_, Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Owl, could you rescue him on your back?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "I don't think so," said Owl, after grave thought.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "It is doubtful if the necessary dorsal muscles----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Then would you fly to him at _once_ and say that Rescue is Coming?

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And Pooh and I will think of a Rescue and come as quick as ever we can.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Oh, don't _talk_, Owl, go on quick!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And, still thinking of something to say, Owl flew off.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Now then, Pooh," said Christopher Robin, "where's your boat?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "I ought to say," explained Pooh as they walked down to the shore of the island, "that it isn't just an ordinary sort of boat.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Sometimes it's a Boat, and sometimes it's more of an Accident.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It all depends."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Depends on what?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "On whether I'm on the top of it or underneath it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Oh!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Well, where is it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "There!" said Pooh, pointing proudly to _The Floating Bear_.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It wasn't what Christopher Robin expected, and the more he looked at it, the more he thought what a Brave and Clever Bear Pooh was, and the more Christopher Robin thought this, the more Pooh looked modestly down his nose and tried to pretend he wasn't.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "But it's too small for two of us," said Christopher Robin sadly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "Three of us with Piglet."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "That makes it smaller still.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Oh, Pooh Bear, what shall we do?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And then this Bear, Pooh Bear, Winnie-the-Pooh, F.O.P. (Friend of Piglet's), R.C. (Rabbit's Companion), P.D. (Pole Discoverer), E.C. and T.F. (Eeyore's Comforter and Tail-finder)--in fact, Pooh himself--said something so clever that Christopher Robin could only look at him with mouth open and eyes staring, wondering if this was really the Bear of Very Little Brain whom he had known and loved so long.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "We might go in your umbrella," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "We might go in your umbrella," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "We might go in your umbrella," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: For suddenly Christopher Robin saw that they might.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He opened his umbrella and put it point downwards in the water.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: It floated but wobbled.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Pooh got in.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: He was just beginning to say that it was all right now, when he found that it wasn't, so after a short drink which he didn't really want he waded back to Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Then they both got in together, and it wobbled no longer.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.alt: The bear climbs into an upside-down umbrella floating as a boat; Christopher Robin in big boots looks on with approval.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: "I shall call this boat _The Brain of Pooh_," said Christopher Robin, and _The Brain of Pooh_ set sail forthwith in a south-westerly direction, revolving gracefully.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: You can imagine Piglet's joy when at last the ship came in sight of him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: In after-years he liked to think that he had been in Very Great Danger during the Terrible Flood, but the only danger he had really been in was in the last half-hour of his imprisonment, when Owl, who had just flown up, sat on a branch of his tree to comfort him, and told him a very long story about an aunt who had once laid a seagull's egg by mistake, and the story went on and on, rather like this sentence, until Piglet who was listening out of his window without much hope, went to sleep quietly and naturally, slipping slowly out of the window towards the water until he was only hanging on by his toes, at which moment luckily, a sudden loud squawk from Owl, which was really part of the story, being what his aunt said, woke the Piglet up and just gave him time to jerk himself back into safety and say, "How interesting, and did she?" when--well, you can imagine his joy when at last he saw the good ship, _Brain of Pooh_ (_Captain_, C. Robin; _1st Mate_, P. Bear) coming over the sea to rescue him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: Christopher Robin and Pooh again....

saetze.kapitel: Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
Chapter IX: In Which Piglet Is Entirely Surrounded by Water
saetze.text: And that is really the end of the story, and I am very tired after that last sentence, I think I shall stop there.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: One day when the sun had come back over the Forest, bringing with it the scent of may, and all the streams of the Forest were tinkling happily to find themselves their own pretty shape again, and the little pools lay dreaming of the life they had seen and the big things they had done, and in the warmth and quiet of the Forest the cuckoo was trying over his voice carefully and listening to see if he liked it, and wood-pigeons were complaining gently to themselves in their lazy comfortable way that it was the other fellow's fault, but it didn't matter very much; on such a day as this Christopher Robin whistled in a special way he had, and Owl came flying out of the Hundred Acre Wood to see what was wanted.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Owl," said Christopher Robin, "I am going to give a party."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "You are, are you?" said Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "And it's to be a special sort of party, because it's because of what Pooh did when he did what he did to save Piglet from the flood."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Oh, that's what it's for, is it?" said Owl.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Yes, so will you tell Pooh as quickly as you can, and all the others, because it will be to-morrow."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Oh, it will, will it?" said Owl, still being as helpful as possible.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "So will you go and tell them, Owl?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Owl tried to think of something very wise to say, but couldn't, so he flew off to tell the others.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: And the first person he told was Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Pooh," he said, "Christopher Robin is giving a party."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: And then seeing that Owl expected him to say something else, he said "Will there be those little cake things with pink sugar icing?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Owl felt that it was rather beneath him to talk about little cake things with pink sugar icing, so he told Pooh exactly what Christopher Robin had said, and flew off to Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "A party for Me?" thought Pooh to himself.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "How grand!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: And he began to wonder if all the other animals would know that it was a special Pooh Party, and if Christopher Robin had told them about _The Floating Bear_ and the _Brain of Pooh_ and all the wonderful ships he had invented and sailed on, and he began to think how awful it would be if everybody had forgotten about it, and nobody quite knew what the party was for; and the more he thought like this, the more the party got muddled in his mind, like a dream when nothing goes right.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: And the dream began to sing itself over in his head until it became a sort of song.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: It was an

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: ANXIOUS POOH SONG.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text:
3 Cheers for Pooh!
(_For Who?_)
For Pooh--
(_Why what did he do?_)
I thought you knew;
He saved his friend from a wetting!
3 Cheers for Bear!
(_For where?_)
For Bear--
He couldn't swim,
But he rescued him!
(_He rescued who?_)
Oh, listen, do!
I am talking of Pooh--
(_Of who?_)
Of Pooh!
(_I'm sorry I keep forgetting_).
Well, Pooh was a Bear of Enormous Brain
(_Just say it again!_)
Of enormous brain--
(_Of enormous what?_)
Well, he ate a lot,
And I don't know if he could swim or not,
But he managed to float
On a sort of boat
(_On a sort of what?_)
Well, a sort of pot--
So now let's give him three hearty cheers
(_So now let's give him three hearty whiches?_)
And hope he'll be with us for years and years,
And grow in health and wisdom and riches!
3 Cheers for Pooh!
(_For who?_)
For Pooh--
3 Cheers for Bear!
(_For where?_)
For Bear--
3 Cheers for the wonderful Winnie-the-Pooh!
(_Just tell me, somebody_--WHAT DID HE DO?)

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: While this was going on inside him, Owl was talking to Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Eeyore," said Owl, "Christopher Robin is giving a party."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Very interesting," said Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "I suppose they will be sending me down the odd bits which got trodden on.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Kind and Thoughtful.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Not at all, don't mention it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "There is an Invitation for you."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "What's that like?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "An Invitation!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Yes, I heard you.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Who dropped it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "This isn't anything to eat, it's asking you to the party.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: To-morrow."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Eeyore shook his head slowly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "You mean Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: The little fellow with the excited ears.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: That's Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: I'll tell him."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "No, no!" said Owl, getting quite fussy.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "It's you!"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Are you sure?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Of course I'm sure.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Christopher Robin said 'All of them!

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Tell all of them.'"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "All of them, except Eeyore?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "All of them," said Owl sulkily.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Ah!" said Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "A mistake, no doubt, but still, I shall come.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Only don't blame _me_ if it rains."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: But it didn't rain.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Christopher Robin had made a long table out of some long pieces of wood, and they all sat round it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Christopher Robin sat at one end, and Pooh sat at the other, and between them on one side were Owl and Eeyore and Piglet, and between them on the other side were Rabbit, and Roo and Kanga.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: And all Rabbit's friends and relations spread themselves about on the grass, and waited hopefully in case anybody spoke to them, or dropped anything, or asked them the time.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: It was the first party to which Roo had ever been, and he was very excited.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: As soon as ever they had sat down he began to talk.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Hallo, Pooh!" he squeaked.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Hallo, Roo!" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Roo jumped up and down in his seat for a little while and then began again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Hallo, Piglet!" he squeaked.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Piglet waved a paw at him, being too busy to say anything.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Hallo, Eeyore!" said Roo.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Eeyore nodded gloomily at him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "It will rain soon, you see if it doesn't," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Roo looked to see if it didn't, and it didn't, so he said "Hallo, Owl!"--and Owl said "Hallo, my little fellow," in a kindly way, and went on telling Christopher Robin about an accident which had nearly happened to a friend of his whom Christopher Robin didn't know, and Kanga said to Roo, "Drink up your milk first, dear, and talk afterwards."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: So Roo, who was drinking his milk, tried to say that he could do both at once ... and had to be patted on the back and dried for quite a long time afterwards.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: When they had all nearly eaten enough, Christopher Robin banged on the table with his spoon, and everybody stopped talking and was very silent, except Roo who was just finishing a loud attack of hiccups and trying to look as if it was one of Rabbit's relations.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.alt: A party under the trees: Christopher Robin stands at a long table speaking to everyone; at the table Rabbit, Kanga and Roo, the bear, Piglet, Eeyore and Owl; small animals all around.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "This party," said Christopher Robin, "is a party because of what someone did, and we all know who it was, and it's his party, because of what he did, and I've got a present for him and here it is."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Then he felt about a little and whispered, "Where is it?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: While he was looking, Eeyore coughed in an impressive way and began to speak.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Friends," he said, "including oddments, it is a great pleasure, or perhaps I had better say it has been a pleasure so far, to see you at my party.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: What I did was nothing.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Any of you--except Rabbit and Owl and Kanga--would have done the same.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Oh, and Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: My remarks do not, of course, apply to Piglet and Roo, because they are too small.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Any of you would have done the same.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: But it just happened to be Me.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: It was not, I need hardly say, with an idea of getting what Christopher Robin is looking for now"--and he put his front leg to his mouth and said in a loud whisper, "Try under the table"--"that I did what I did--but because I feel that we should all do what we can to help.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: I feel that we should all----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "H--hup!" said Roo accidentally.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Roo, dear!" said Kanga reproachfully.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Was it me?" asked Roo, a little surprised.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "What's Eeyore talking about?" Piglet whispered to Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "I don't know," said Pooh rather dolefully.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "I thought this was _your_ party."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "I thought it was _once_.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: But I suppose it isn't."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "I'd sooner it was yours than Eeyore's," said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "So would I," said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "H--hup!" said Roo again.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "AS--I--WAS--SAYING," said Eeyore loudly and sternly, "as I was saying when I was interrupted by various Loud Sounds, I feel that----"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Here it is!" cried Christopher Robin excitedly.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Pass it down to silly old Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: It's for Pooh."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "For Pooh?" said Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Of course it is.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: The best bear in all the world."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "I might have known," said Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "After all, one can't complain.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: I have my friends.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Somebody spoke to me only yesterday.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: And was it last week or the week before that Rabbit bumped into me and said 'Bother!'

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: The Social Round.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Always something going on."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Nobody was listening, for they were all saying "Open it, Pooh," "What is it, Pooh?" "I know what it is," "No, you don't" and other helpful remarks of this sort.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: And of course Pooh was opening it as quickly as ever he could, but without cutting the string, because you never know when a bit of string might be Useful.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: At last it was undone.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: When Pooh saw what it was, he nearly fell down, he was so pleased.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: It was a Special Pencil Case.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: There were pencils in it marked "B" for Bear, and pencils marked "HB" for Helping Bear, and pencils marked "BB" for Brave Bear.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: There was a knife for sharpening the pencils, and india-rubber for rubbing out anything which you had spelt wrong, and a ruler for ruling lines for the words to walk on, and inches marked on the ruler in case you wanted to know how many inches anything was, and Blue Pencils and Red Pencils and Green Pencils for saying special things in blue and red and green.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: And all these lovely things were in little pockets of their own in a Special Case which shut with a click when you clicked it.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: And they were all for Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Oh!" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Oh, Pooh!" said everybody else except Eeyore.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Thank-you," growled Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: But Eeyore was saying to himself, "This writing business.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Pencils and what-not.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Over-rated, if you ask me.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Silly stuff.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Nothing in it."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Later on, when they had all said "Good-bye" and "Thank-you" to Christopher Robin, Pooh and Piglet walked home thoughtfully together in the golden evening, and for a long time they were silent.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.alt: The bear and Piglet walk home together into the golden evening sunset; the bear carries his present.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "When you wake up in the morning, Pooh," said Piglet at last, "what's the first thing you say to yourself?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "What's for breakfast?" said Pooh.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "What do _you_ say, Piglet?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "I say, I wonder what's going to happen exciting _to-day_?" said Piglet.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: Pooh nodded thoughtfully.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "It's the same thing," he said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "And what did happen?" asked Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "When?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Next morning."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "I don't know."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Could you think and tell me and Pooh some time?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "If you wanted it very much."

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Pooh does," said Christopher Robin.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: He gave a deep sigh, picked his bear up by the leg and walked off to the door, trailing Winnie-the-Pooh behind him.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: At the door he turned and said "Coming to see me have my bath?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "I might," I said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "Was Pooh's pencil case any better than mine?"

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: "It was just the same," I said.

saetze.kapitel: Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
Chapter X: In Which Christopher Robin Gives Pooh a Party, and We Say Good-bye
saetze.text: He nodded and went out ... and in a moment I heard Winnie-the-Pooh--_bump, bump, bump_--going up the stairs behind him.
